raw.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We continuously enhance our products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Product Discovery & Project Manager to lead early-stage product development by identifying client needs, gathering requirements, and translating business challenges into actionable product solutions.

You will work closely with clients, stakeholders, and technical teams to define product requirements, coordinate project execution, and ensure successful delivery. This role emphasizes product discovery, design thinking, requirements gathering, and project management, with product design supporting the development of user-centered solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Product Discovery & Research

  • Lead discovery sessions, client interviews, and user research, applying design thinking methodologies to identify business challenges, understand user needs, and uncover opportunities for product improvement.
  • Conduct market and competitor research, analyze client feedback, and use design thinking principles to explore, evaluate, and validate potential solutions before development.

Requirements Gathering & Analysis

  • Gather, analyze, and document client and business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflows.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and technical teams to clarify requirements, evaluate feasibility, and ensure alignment on project scope and expected outcomes.

Project Management & Execution

  • Manage project scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities from discovery through implementation.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, monitor progress, resolve blockers, and communicate project updates to clients and leadership.

Product Strategy & Solution Development

  • Translate research findings and business requirements into product recommendations aligned with user needs and company objectives.
  • Collaborate with product leadership and technical teams to evaluate, prioritize, and plan product improvements.

Product Design & Prototyping

  • Apply human-centered design principles to develop practical, intuitive, and user-friendly product solutions.
  • Create or collaborate on wireframes, user flows, and basic prototypes to communicate concepts and validate requirements.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a liaison between clients, business stakeholders, and technical teams to maintain clear communication and alignment.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations, address conflicting requirements, and facilitate discussions to support project decisions.

Leadership & Process Improvement

  • Establish and improve processes, documentation standards, and best practices for product discovery, requirements gathering, and project management.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across product development

A Day in the Life

Your day may involve meeting with clients to understand their workflows and gather requirements, applying design thinking techniques to explore potential solutions, and collaborating with developers to clarify technical specifications. You may also conduct product research, create workflow diagrams or basic prototypes, coordinate project priorities and timelines, and provide project updates to leadership.

Your primary focus is ensuring that client needs are clearly understood, product opportunities are thoroughly explored, requirements are well-defined, and projects move efficiently from discovery to delivery.

Success Metrics

  • Product Discovery & Design Thinking: Effective identification, exploration, and validation of client needs and product opportunities before development.

  • Requirements Quality: Clear, complete documentation that minimizes misunderstandings and development rework.

  • Project Delivery: Timely completion of project milestones and deliverables.

  • Stakeholder Satisfaction: Effective communication and alignment between clients, leadership, and technical teams.

  • Product Improvements: Delivery of solutions that improve client workflows, usability, and business outcomes.

  • Process Efficiency: Continuous improvement in discovery, requirements gathering, and project management processes.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

Senior Benefits Administration Services Analyst

Defined Benefits | Data Analysis | SQL

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Benefits Administration Services Analyst with strong Defined Benefits pension administration and data analysis experience. This role serves as a key data and client subject matter expert, with responsibility for data quality, reporting, process analysis, and supporting data-intensive Defined Benefits initiatives.

The ideal candidate combines Defined Benefits knowledge with strong SQL, advanced Excel, analytical, and client-facing skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a Data Model and Defined Benefits SME, supporting client requirements and pension administration processes.
  • Own and monitor data quality, helping ensure accuracy and integrity across Defined Benefits processes.
  • Serve as a key stakeholder for data-intensive projects, including Actuarial Valuation.
  • Analyze data and operational processes to identify efficiencies, workload reductions, trends, and improvement opportunities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for reporting needs, providing meaningful insights to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Use SQL and advanced Excel to analyze data, investigate discrepancies, validate results, and support reporting.
  • Act as a steward for Conduent Data Requirements, partnering with Data Management and other teams.
  • Research and resolve escalated issues involving eligibility, participant data, systems, and service delivery.
  • Triage system and data issues to confirm adherence to client and business requirements.
  • Serve as an SME for client plan rules, requirements, and expectations.
  • Lead client and system change initiatives from Discovery through Go-Live, including requirements, testing, implementation, and project coordination.
  • Maintain Business Requirements, Administrative Guides, and process documentation, obtaining client sign-off when required.
  • Identify system and processing enhancements that improve quality, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Perform peer reviews and mentor junior team members.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience and/or formal education in Defined Benefits pension administration.
  • Knowledge of Defined Benefits plan rules, participant data, eligibility, and pension administration processes.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Minimum 2 years of SQL query execution and development experience.
  • Experience with data analysis, data quality, reporting, and issue investigation.
  • Experience researching and troubleshooting system, processing, or data issues.
  • Experience working with business requirements and process documentation.
  • Familiarity with the project lifecycle and project management, including Discovery through Go-Live.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Actuarial Valuation or other data-intensive Defined Benefits initiatives.
  • Experience serving as a Data Model SME, Defined Benefits SME, or senior analyst.
  • Experience partnering with Data Management or technical teams.
  • Experience working directly with external clients.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members.

Key Skills

Defined Benefits • Pension Administration • SQL • Advanced Excel • Data Quality • Data Analysis • Data Models • Reporting • Actuarial Valuation • Participant Data • Process Improvement • Business Requirements • Client Management • Project Lifecycle

In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is $85k-95k.

Description

Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, , Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations.

We’re proud to have over 900+ team members across 16 countries worldwide, all working together to build the future of hospitality technology.

If you’re looking to grow your career in a dynamic, global, and impact-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and enhancing the relationships with our SMB clients. You will serve as the primary point of contact, ensuring their needs are met and their expectations are exceeded. Your focus will be on driving client success, fostering growth opportunities, and ultimately contributing to the overall success of our company.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

﻿

Requirements:

  • Languages: Fluent English and Spanish are required; additional languages would be a strong advantage.
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas, negotiating contract terms, and closing deals to drive revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated expertise in client retention strategies, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and long-term partnership development.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and to be an outstanding team player.
  • Familiarity with CRM software (Salesforce preferred)
  • Hospitality or property management industry experience - an advantage

﻿Key Skills:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for effectively engaging with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience in negotiating contract terms, handling objections, and closing deals to drive revenue growth.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • Technical acumen to grasp and communicate complex concepts for seamless collaboration between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional results for clients.

raw.description:
Our Mission and Values

The Aragon Company is a performance marketing agency on a mission to be an indispensable source of growth for our clients. We specialize in customer acquisition for finance, home services, fintech, mobile apps, insurance, gaming, media, consumer, and emerging AI-first companies — helping them scale through affiliate marketing, pay-per-call, and strategic traffic partnerships. Our work is directly focused on our client's ROI, and we're passionate about delivering results that matter.

Whether you're on the front lines with clients or supporting our operations behind the scenes, every role at Aragon contributes to our clients' success and our collective growth.

Our Core Values:

  1. We are an accelerant to our customers' growth.
  2. We thrive in dynamic environments and move with agility.
  3. We are passionate about performance.
  4. We own our outcomes down to the smallest detail.
  5. We cultivate momentum and build forward.

At Aragon, you'll be part of a company that's building something bigger. We deploy products, data, and marketing expertise to create innovative solutions to our clients' customer acquisition challenges. We invest in our people, encourage collaboration across teams, and create an environment where your contributions are recognized and valued. If you're looking for a place where performance matters, where you can grow your career, and where your work has real impact, you'll find your place here.

The Position:

Aragon Premium ( is the affiliate network within The Aragon Company. Our network connects advertisers with affiliates and vetted media buyers across a broad range of verticals including fintech, insurance, home services, rewarded gaming, mobile apps, consumer, and more. We are seeking an Affiliate Manager / Senior Affiliate Manager to recruit, develop, and scale affiliate partnerships across the full range of offers in our network. We have deep advertiser demand and a strong pipeline of affiliate activity to work — this is a relationship-driven, revenue-owning role for someone who can step in on day one and make an immediate impact. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Network Director and Chief Growth Officer, working closely with the account management team.

Key Responsibilities:

Affiliate Recruitment & Network Growth

  • Recruit direct media buyers and affiliate partners across Facebook, Google, native, TikTok, programmatic, push, in-app, email, content, mass media, and search channels.
  • Build and maintain a structured affiliate recruitment pipeline with clear sourcing, qualification, and activation stages.
  • Diversify the network into new channels and traffic types to reduce concentration risk and expand offer placement opportunities.
  • Represent Aragon Premium at industry conferences including Affiliate Summit, LeadsCon, and MAU.

Affiliate Development & Scaling

  • Onboard new affiliates quickly and get them live on the right offers from our existing base of advertiser demand.
  • Grow revenue and profit by matching affiliates to new offers, verticals, and payout structures.
  • Build durable, consultative relationships with affiliates — serving as their primary point of contact and day-to-day advocate inside Aragon Premium.
  • Analyze partner-level performance (EPC, CVR, volume, margin) and act on the levers that scale it: creative, placement, caps, and payouts.
  • Own a book of affiliate revenue against clear monthly and quarterly growth targets.

Partnering with Account Management

  • Work closely with account managers to match affiliate supply to advertiser demand and fill open capacity across the offer portfolio.
  • Relay advertiser-side quality and performance feedback to affiliates and adjust activity accordingly.
  • Flag scaling opportunities, cap increases, and new offer needs to account management before affiliates hit ceilings.

Quality, Compliance & Performance

  • Vet affiliates pre-activation, including evaluation of traffic sources, promotional methods, and economic viability.
  • Monitor affiliate performance against EPC and CVR benchmarks by traffic source, and identify fraud signals or economically incoherent performance and act decisively to resolve.
  • Enforce compliance standards in alignment with advertiser, network, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications:

  • 4-8+ years of affiliate or performance marketing experience, with the majority of it on the network side.
  • Affiliate network experience is required — you have managed affiliates inside a network, not exclusively on the agency or advertiser side.
  • Demonstrated experience managing affiliate media buyers and evaluating the economics of traffic sources.
  • Hands-on Everflow experience — able to pull, read, and act on network reporting without support.
  • Track record of hands-on affiliate recruitment, development, and revenue growth at scale.
  • Relationship-driven sales instincts — comfortable prospecting, pitching offers, negotiating payouts, and closing.
  • Experience across a broad mix of offer types (CPA, CPL, CPI, CPE) and verticals, with the ability to step into an active pipeline and produce from day one.
  • Strong fraud detection instincts and pattern recognition for economically incoherent performance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with mobile app offers (CPI, CPA, CPE) and lead generation offers in regulated verticals.
  • Existing relationships with direct media buyers and publishers.
  • Familiarity with additional affiliate tracking platforms (TUNE, Impact, CJ, or similar).
Salary: $80,000 - $90,000 (Depends on Experience)

About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Principal Software Engineer, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Healthcare Subject Matter Expert in Product Management to join our team!
raw.description:
We are looking for a Healthcare Subject Matter Expert in Product Management to join our team!

  • Are you passionate about helping healthcare organizations navigate complex regulatory and compliance challenges?
  • Do you enjoy translating real-world healthcare requirements into innovative product solutions that deliver measurable value for customers?

Who we are:

SAI360 is giving companies a new perspective on risk management. By integrating Governance, Risk, Compliance (GRC) software and Ethics & Compliance Learning resources, SAI360 can broaden your risk horizon and increase your ability to identify, manage, and mitigate risk. See risk from every angle. Visit www.sai360.com.

Think you're a fit for SAI360?

As a Sr. Product Manager, you will serve as the domain authority on how healthcare organizations manage governance, risk, compliance (GRC), and ethics programs. You will translate real-world regulatory and operational needs into clear user stories and requirements that help shape our product roadmap. You will also work directly with customers and prospects, bringing credibility and insight to conversations about how our platform solves their most pressing challenges.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the go-to expert on healthcare GRC needs, including regulatory compliance, enterprise risk management, third-party and vendor risk, policy management, audit, and ethics and compliance programs.
  • Write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements that reflect how healthcare organizations actually operate, and partner with Product Managers to prioritize them.
  • Translate complex regulatory requirements such as HIPAA, HITRUST, CMS, OIG compliance program guidance, FDA, and state-level requirements into product capabilities.
  • Conduct customer and prospect discovery sessions, workshops, and demos to understand workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes.
  • Validate product designs and prototypes against healthcare industry practices and provide feedback to UX and Engineering teams.
  • Stay current on regulatory changes, industry trends, and competitive developments in healthcare compliance and risk management and share those insights across the organization.
  • Support sales and customer success teams with domain-specific guidance during evaluations, implementations, and renewals.
  • Contribute to product documentation, training materials, and thought leadership initiatives including blogs, webinars, and conference presentations.

What you'll bring to the table:

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare compliance, risk management, audit, or a related GRC function within health systems, payers, pharmaceutical, medical device, or healthcare services organizations.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare regulations and frameworks such as HIPAA, the False Claims Act, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, and HITRUST or similar security frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear user stories, requirements, or process documentation.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain regulatory concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience engaging directly with customers or prospects in discovery sessions, workshops, or presentations.
  • Experience with GRC software platforms or working alongside them in a compliance or risk role preferred.
  • Familiarity with Agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Aha! preferred.
  • Certifications such as CHC, CHPC, CIA, CISA, CRMA, or CHRC are beneficial.
  • Experience in product management, business analysis, or solution consulting preferred.
  • Experience with enterprise customers across multiple healthcare sub-sectors preferred.

In the interest of Pay Transparency, the base salary range for this position is $125,000 to $150,000 annually, plus eligibility for applicable bonus programs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Why you should apply to SAI360:

Alongside a remote-first hiring strategy and competitive salary package, we offer a wide variety of employee perks including:

PTO leave;

Quarterly wellness days;

EAP program;

Healthcare benefits;

Bonus incentives;

401(k) match;

Pet insurance;

FSA account;

Salary: $125,000 to $150,000 plus 10% bonus

About the Company

Our client is a UK-based manufacturer of premium syrups, sauces and toppings designed for the beverage, coffee and dessert industries. With an established business and a strong presence in the UK market, the company is now looking to accelerate its international expansion, with Poland as one of its key strategic markets.

The company works with B2B customers across various channels, including distributors, wholesalers, HoReCa, coffee shops and foodservice businesses. It combines an entrepreneurial mindset with ambitious growth plans and is now looking for a commercially driven professional to establish and develop its presence in Poland.

The Role

We are looking for a proactive and entrepreneurial Regional Business Development Manager to take ownership of the company's commercial development in Poland.

This is a standalone, market-building role with a strong focus on new business acquisition. You will be responsible for developing the local market from the ground up, identifying new commercial opportunities, establishing distribution partnerships and introducing the company's product portfolio to relevant customers and channels.

You will have considerable autonomy in shaping the local sales approach, developing relationships and driving commercial growth, while working closely with the UK-based Sales Manager and supporting teams.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building businesses, opening new markets and turning commercial opportunities into long-term partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Polish market, identifying growth opportunities and prioritising relevant sales channels.

  • Build the company's local presence and develop its distribution network from the ground up.

  • Actively identify, approach and acquire new B2B customers, distributors, wholesalers and strategic business partners.

  • Develop relationships across HoReCa, coffee shop chains, independent cafés, foodservice, catering, retail and other relevant channels.

  • Introduce and promote the company's portfolio of syrups, sauces and toppings, demonstrating their commercial applications and value to potential customers.

  • Lead the full sales cycle, from prospecting and initial contact through product presentations, negotiations and contract closure.

  • Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and distribution agreements in line with the company's commercial guidelines.

  • Build long-term relationships with distributors and key customers, supporting their development and maximising sales potential.

  • Identify market trends, competitor activities, customer needs and pricing dynamics to strengthen the company's positioning in Poland.

  • Develop local business plans, sales forecasts and budgets, monitoring performance against revenue and profitability targets.

  • Work closely with UK-based Marketing, Customer Service and Supply Chain teams to ensure effective customer onboarding and commercial execution.

  • Represent the company at relevant industry events, trade shows and networking opportunities.

  • Regularly report on market development, sales performance and new business opportunities to the UK-based management team.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or commercial roles within FMCG, food & beverage, foodservice or a related industry.

  • Proven experience in actively acquiring new customers and developing business from scratch.

  • Experience working with distributors, wholesalers and/or B2B partners.

  • Good understanding of the Polish FMCG, HoReCa and/or foodservice markets, including relevant distribution channels and key market players.

  • A strong commercial mindset, with experience in negotiating pricing, margins, contracts and business terms.

  • Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and drive profitable business growth.

  • Experience working independently and taking ownership of commercial activities in a relatively autonomous environment.

  • Strong networking, negotiation

    What the Company Offers

    • Opportunity to build and develop the Polish market for an established UK-based brand.

    • A high level of autonomy and direct influence on the company's international expansion.

    • Direct cooperation with the UK-based Sales Manager and access to international support teams.

    • Support from Marketing, Customer Service and Supply Chain functions based in the UK.

    • Employment contract in Poland, managed through Deel.

    • Competitive base salary combined with a performance-related commission scheme linked to the profitability of the business generated.

    • Regular business trips to the UK, approximately once per quarter.

    • A dynamic, entrepreneurial working environment with opportunities to shape the company's future growth.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

Experience working with AI startups, SaaS companies, tech companies, digital agencies, or other high-growth businesses is highly preferred.
What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day client engagements and ensure projects stay on track.
  • Coordinate between clients, internal teams, and remote talent to keep deliverables moving.
  • Monitor project progress, priorities, deadlines, and potential roadblocks.
  • Proactively identify issues and recommend practical solutions before they become bigger problems.
  • Build strong working relationships with clients while maintaining clear boundaries and expectations.
  • Translate client needs into clear action items for internal teams.
  • Use project management, collaboration, and productivity tools to organize workflows and track progress.
  • Maintain visibility across multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Help improve processes, workflows, documentation, and systems as the business scales.
  • Analyze operational information and use data to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Work closely with leadership to resolve escalations and improve the overall client experience.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities, new technologies, and evolving business needs.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in client operations, customer success, account management, project management, business operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience working in a technology-driven, startup, SaaS, AI, or high-growth environment is strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn new tools and systems.
  • Comfortable working across platforms such as project management tools, CRMs, communication platforms, spreadsheets, and other cloud-based systems.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Highly proactive — able to identify what needs to be done without waiting for instructions.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment.

You'll Be a Great Fit If You

  • Enjoy figuring out how systems and processes can work better.
  • Are naturally curious about technology and new tools.
  • Can move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Think in terms of solutions, processes, and outcomes, rather than simply completing assigned tasks.
  • Are comfortable working directly with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Have experience in a startup or environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Can take ownership of an engagement from problem identification through resolution.

Important
This role is best suited for candidates with experience in tech, SaaS, AI, startups, digital operations, project management, or client operations.
Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to traditional call-center, BPO, or highly scripted customer service environments may not be the best fit for this position.

raw.description:
Join the G2i Talent Pool

We’re always meeting great people in tech. Join the G2i Talent Pool and let us get to know you.

G2i works with top AI labs and fast-growing companies. Our community of engineers works on real projects, from evals and RL environments to training data for frontier models.

Who we’re looking for
Software, data, AI/ML, infrastructure, security, design, QA and product. Experienced or just starting out, fresh graduates are welcome. If you work in tech or are building your career in it, we’d love to meet you.

How it works

  1. Apply in a few minutes with your real details and links.

  2. We review your profile and send you a short technical assessment.

  3. Once you pass, you join our pool and hear from us when a project fits your skills.

Joining the pool doesn’t mean immediate work, since matching depends on what our clients need and on each profile. But we’re always working to match everyone in our pool with the right project.

Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client.

raw.description:
Cross-Cloud Architect – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cross-Cloud Architect
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $175,000–$200,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Cross-Cloud Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in cloud architecture roles.
  • Hands-on architecture experience across at least two major cloud providers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.
  • Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Multiple cloud certifications across providers.
  • Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).
  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic observability platforms.
  • Experience driving large-scale cloud-to-cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with multi-cloud mandates.
  • Public talks or writing on multi-cloud architecture.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to  or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.title: Product Engineer - AI Finance
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Staff Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Email App
raw.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
raw.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Staff Software Engineer, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Admin Executive Assistant to support executive administration, operational coordination, compliance workflows, client onboarding, and documentation within an IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) environment.

This is more than a traditional administrative role. You’ll serve as an important operational control layer, ensuring information is accurate, documentation is complete, follow-ups happen on time, and critical details don’t get missed.

Because the business operates in a compliance-sensitive environment, precision, organization, confidentiality, and attention to detail are essential.

If you’re someone who catches inconsistencies others miss, enjoys creating order, and takes ownership of tasks through completion, this role is a strong fit.

  • Track required documentation and follow up on missing items

  • Ensure required information and documentation are collected
  • Monitor outstanding tasks, follow-ups, and internal dependencies
  • Maintain clear visibility into onboarding status
  • Coordinate with clients and internal stakeholders throughout the process
  • Escalate missing information, blockers, or potential delays proactively
  • Ensure onboarding steps are completed accurately and on time

Quality Control & Accuracy

  • Review names, dates, numbers, schedules, records, and documentation before execution
  • Identify inconsistencies across systems and workflows
  • Catch potential errors before they create operational or financial issues
  • Track process and documentation changes accurately
  • Double-check critical information before submission or execution
  • Maintain strong quality-control standards across daily operations

Systems & Records Management

  • Maintain organized and accurate records across tools such as:
    • Google Workspace
    • Slack
    • Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Keep systems clean, searchable, and up to date
  • Maintain consistent naming and documentation practices
  • Ensure important information can be retrieved quickly when needed
  • Update CRM and internal systems as operational information changes
  • Maintain reliable records across administrative and compliance workflows

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations Support roles
  • Strong experience with Google Workspace
  • Experience using Slack
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities without sacrificing accuracy
  • Strong follow-through and organizational discipline
  • Ability to work independently and solve problems proactively
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality
  • Comfortable working in a process-driven environment
  • Ability to work during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience in IT Asset Disposition (ITAD)
  • Experience in compliance-heavy or highly regulated environments
  • Familiarity with audit preparation and compliance documentation
  • Experience supporting founders, executives, or leadership teams
  • Client onboarding experience
  • Operational tracking and workflow management experience
  • Experience maintaining structured records across multiple systems

Tools & Technology

Google Workspace | Gmail | Google Drive | Google Docs | Google Sheets | Google Calendar | Slack | Salesforce | CRM Systems | Documentation & Workflow Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Notice small inconsistencies quickly
  • Naturally double-check important information
  • Prefer structured and organized systems
  • Take ownership instead of waiting to be reminded
  • Follow tasks through until they are completely resolved
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Handle confidential information responsibly
  • Stay organized while managing multiple priorities
  • Proactively flag risks instead of waiting for problems to escalate
  • Understand that accuracy is just as important as speed

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing leadership calendars, outstanding action items, client onboarding progress, and documentation requiring attention.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate meetings, review records for missing or incorrect information, follow up on operational tasks, update Salesforce and internal systems, and organize compliance documentation.

You’ll also coordinate communication between clients and internal teams, verify important dates and records, and proactively flag inconsistencies or risks before they create larger problems.

In short: you ensure the administrative and operational side of the business stays accurate, organized, compliant, and under control.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and completeness of documentation
  • Zero critical operational or documentation errors
  • On-time completion of assigned tasks and follow-ups
  • Smooth and timely client onboarding
  • CRM and internal records accuracy
  • Audit-readiness of compliance documentation
  • Reduction in preventable operational issues
  • Consistency of administrative workflows
  • Leadership confidence in administrative and operational execution

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-trust role working closely with leadership
  • Direct impact on operational accuracy and compliance
  • Exposure to structured ITAD and compliance workflows
  • Strong ownership over administrative and operational processes
  • Opportunity to improve documentation and workflow consistency
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:

Apply today and take on a high-trust role where your attention to detail directly contributes to smoother operations, stronger compliance, accurate client onboarding, and greater leadership efficiency.

raw.excerpt: Are you obsessed with turning insights into measurable growth?
raw.description:
Are you obsessed with turning insights into measurable growth?

What if your experiments didn’t just lift conversions but shaped how millions of people grow, learn, and act on their potential?

This isn’t another growth job.

It’s the chance to define a new category : The EcoSystem for Human Greatness Augmented with AI, combining behavioral science, technology, and AI.

We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it.

A hands-on Growth profile who can ideate, copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.

Someone who speaks both data and persuasion fluently, and leverages AI tools daily to generate hypotheses, build assets, and accelerate iteration speed.

And you deserve it because you are…

  • 🛠️ You're not "a marketer who runs campaigns." You're a builder. You see a funnel and your hands itch to ship a landing page, wire up an automation, and launch the test by Friday.

    🤖 You leverage Claude Code daily, not occasionally. It's not a nice-to-have, it's how you do the job of five people alone: building automations, generating and iterating assets, shipping scripts that used to take a dev.

    ⚡️ You'd rather ship a scrappy v1 today than a perfect plan next quarter. Bias to action is your default setting.

    📊 You make decisions with data. You can read a cohort chart, smell a vanity metric, and tell the difference between a result and a coincidence.

    You've got 2–3 years under your belt, you're hungry, and you want to walk into a startup and crush it.

Then this job might be for you!

This is a full-time position, carried out remotely or from our beautiful offices in Dubaï.

French and English fluency is required.

About Paradox

WHAT WE DO

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox, we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can translate insight into transformation, through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

And that’s where you come in.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

Be the hands-on builder inside the Growth team. You take funnels apart, rebuild them to convert better, and ship the experiments yourself : copy, landing pages, automations, AI-assisted assets.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build & ship experiments (CRO & A/B Testing) - You design, launch, and analyze A/B tests yourself : headlines, pricing, offers. You don't wait for a report, you dig into the data to find the winner.

2. AI leverage - Leveraging Claude Code and lightweight automation (n8n/Make) isn't optional here, it's core to the role. Every day, you use AI to build prompt pipelines, generate and iterate creatives, ship small tools/scripts, and turn manual grind into background processes, doing the output of a 5-person team on your own.

3. Build funnels & assets (Hands-On) - You map funnels and build them: landing pages in Webflow, automations, tracking setup. You check the flows and make sure the machine works before anything scales.

4. Hunt friction - You proactively look for drop-off points in the user journey. If a page isn't converting, you audit it, propose a fix, and ship the test immediately with the team.

5. Read the data - You live in GA4, Amplitude, Hotjar, Clarity. You find the insight behind the numbers, kill vanity metrics, and make sure learnings compound over time.

6. Contribute to channels & growth loops - Alongside the team, you test new acquisition angles and help optimize growth loops (retention, referral, content → product → content). You bring data-backed briefs to the Content Factory and spot winning angles fast.

Tools you’ll master:
GA4, Optibase, Wefblow, Vidalytics, Clarity, Hotjar, Amplitude, Figma, Looker Studio, VWO, Optimizely, and whatever helps you see what others miss.

You’ll own KPIs :

  • LTV / CAC ratio

  • Funnel conversion rates by stage

  • X experiments launched per week

Desired Outcomes

  • Conversion Rates 2× better than baseline

  • Growth experimentation runs continuously

  • A Predictable Growth Engine

DO YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF?

Experience

  • 2–3 years in Growth, CRO, Growth Experimentation, or Performance Marketing, ideally around SaaS, e-commerce, or digital products. Or you're a self-taught operator with the receipts to prove it.

  • You can show us what you've built and shipped : tests, landing pages, automations, audiences. Portfolio > pedigree. A scrappy before/after beats a polished CV.

  • You already use AI daily to create leverage and solve complex issues.

Personality

  • Curiosity: You relentlessly dig into why users behave the way they do until you uncover the insight behind the data.

  • Hands-On Execution : you build, you don't just brief.

  • Precision: You care about clarity in hypotheses, clean data, and unambiguous results.

  • Agility: You move fast, adapt instantly to new findings, and turn insights into tests within hours, not weeks.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

  1. You want a strict separation between work and life. Execution speed is our biggest advantage right now. A 9-to-5 mindset guarantees you'll fall behind.

  2. You need clarity, stability, and established process before you can act. We're still building the machine. If you need everything defined before you move, wrong place.

  3. You want to be told exactly what to do. We hire people who bring solutions, not people who wait for instructions.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

“I started my company.”

“I found peace with my father.”

You will play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.

Growth & Ambition

-> 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Impact & Meaning

->Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people

->Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!
We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reach a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

-> ❤️ Contributing to the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers

But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

-> 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

-> 🗽Flexible working hours

-> 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

-> 💻Work on Mac, for us it counts :)

HIRING PROCESS 📃

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey.

💻 A 15-30 minutes video call, to assess the fit between the position, the company, and your own career path.
💻 A video-call focused on your career to review your background & see how we can match your desires with our needs.
💻 Aculture-fit video call to check in depth the alignment between you and our values and culture.
💼 Reference calls to get in-depth insights about how you work in different environments, make your onboarding easier, and give everybody on the team the insurance to be surrounded by A-Players.
🤗 Welcome aboard!

If you’re not joining to tweak landing pages.
If you’re here to engineer behavioral change at scale, for millions.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

Software, data, AI/ML, infrastructure, security, design, QA and product. Experienced or just starting out, fresh graduates are welcome. If you work in tech or are building your career in it, we’d love to meet you.
