Job Title: MSL/Sr. MSL Oncology, Multiple Myeloma (PA/MD/DC)

Job Location: Pittsburgh, PA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:


Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn,Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

The MSL/Sr. MSL is the field-based scientific expert responsible for advancing scientific and medical understanding of AbbVie’s therapeutic areas through high-quality, non-promotional scientific exchange. The role serves as AbbVie’s scientific face in the field, building trusted relationships with healthcare professionals and scientific experts, generating actionable healthcare professional perspectives and Scientific Intelligence, and supporting evidence generation activities that inform medical strategy and contribute to improved patient outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver high-quality, balanced, and compliant scientific exchange with healthcare professionals and scientific experts, tailored to clinical context and informational needs.
  • Build and sustain credible, trust based scientific relationships that enable meaningful two-way dialogue and Scientific Intelligence.
  • Interpret and communicate AbbVie and therapeutic landscape data, disease state knowledge, and evolving standards of care with clarity and scientific rigor.
  • Generate, document, and share healthcare professional perspectives and Scientific Intelligence to inform medical planning and evidence generation activities.
  • Support evidence generation activities by raising scientific awareness of clinical research and engaging investigators where appropriate.
  • Translate complex scientific and clinical information into clear, relevant discussions aligned to stakeholder needs.
  • Collaborate effectively with Medical Affairs and Health Impact (MHI) colleagues, Clinical Development, Evidence Generation partners, and the In-Field team (IFT).
  • Plan and execute scientific engagement activities aligned with medical objectives and territory priorities.
  • Utilize approved tools, channels, and engagement approaches to optimize scientific exchange while maintaining full compliance.
  • Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant documentation of scientific interactions and Scientific Intelligence in accordance with AbbVie policies and applicable regulatory standards.

Qualifications

  • Advanced scientific degree required (PharmD, PhD, MD, PA, NP, or equivalent).
  • Experience in Medical Affairs, clinical research, academic science, or other scientific or healthcare roles.
  • Experience engaging healthcare professionals or scientific stakeholders in evidence-based scientific discussions, ideally in the multiple myeloma landscape.
  • Foundational understanding of disease areas, mechanisms of action, and standards of care.
  • Working knowledge of clinical research principles, evidence types, and study design.
  • Experience interpreting scientific literature, clinical trial data, or real-world evidence in a professional setting.
  • Experience collaborating with cross functional medical and scientific partners.

Key Stakeholders:

  • Healthcare professionals in the multiple myeloma space
  • Scientific experts and thought leaders
  • Clinical investigators and research site personnel
  • MHI leadership and therapeutic area teams
  • Evidence Generation and Clinical Development partners
  • Regulatory, safety, and medical information colleagues
  • Cross-functional team​​

The candidate must live in the territory or willing to self-relocate within the territory.

Job grade, level, and title will be determined by the selected candidate’s credentials, education, and experience.


Additional Information

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

  • The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​

  • This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission,incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless anduntil paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

Job Description: Senior SAP SD & Vistex Functional Consultant
Position Title: Senior SAP SD & Vistex Functional Consultant
Position Type: Full-time | Remote (with up to 10-15% travel based on project milestones)
Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior SAP SD & Vistex Functional Consultant to lead the architecture, configuration, and optimization of our Order-to-Cash (OTC) and enterprise incentive management landscapes. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex commercial business processes and SAP functional design. You will design solutions for pricing models, complex rebate structures, chargebacks, and distributor claims using both standard SAP SD and advanced Vistex applications.
Key Responsibilities
  • Solution Architecture & Configuration: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and configuration of SAP SD (Sales, Shipping, Billing, Pricing Procedures) and Vistex modules (Incentives, Rebates, Billbacks, Chargebacks, Claims, and Deal Management).
  • Business Process Optimization: Conduct blueprinting workshops, requirement gathering, and fit-gap analyses to align commercial strategies with SAP and Vistex best practices.
  • S/4HANA Modernization: Optimize the core OTC data model using S/4HANA-optimized structures, leveraging Settlement Management where appropriate to simplify commercial incentive processing.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Oversee seamless technical integration between SAP SD/Vistex and adjacent modules, including FI-CO (Revenue Recognition, Profitability Analysis), MM, and PP.
  • Technical Collaboration: Partner with ABAP developers and technical architects to design custom extensions, user exits, and interfaces when standard SAP functional features are exhausted, strictly adhering to a "clean core" philosophy.
  • Testing & Delivery: Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), regression testing, data migration, and cutover execution during deployment phases.[1]
Required Qualifications
  • Experience: 8–12+ years of hands-on functional experience in SAP SD, with a minimum of 4–5 years dedicated to implementing and supporting Vistex solutions.
  • Core SD Expertise: Deep expertise in SAP SD Master Data, Pricing Procedures, Access Sequences, Condition Types, Available-to-Promise (ATP), Credit Management, and Billing.
  • Vistex Specialization: Expert knowledge in Vistex IP (Incentive Administration) and DM (Data Maintenance) concepts, including calculation line items, deployment codes, matrix structures, status flows, and accrual/settlement frameworks.
  • Platform Proficiency: Proven experience working in SAP S/4HANA environments and navigating structural changes, such as the evolution from traditional SD indexes to CDS views.
  • Soft Skills: Strong consultative mindset with the ability to explain complex technical solutions to non-technical business stakeholders.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Product Owner Technical to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner Technical, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
This isn’t another product job.

It’s the chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

A chance to build an AI-native Product Department

You’ll be working with the most complex data in the world : the human mind.

Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…

  • 🚀Ambition around AI field : Smart teammates driven to create an iconic, international product

  • 🔥Impact : you strive to make a real difference in the company's growth, and not be a number in a big organization

  • 😍Mission : knowing your greatness left a mark in people's lives, through technology and behavioral science

At Paradox, we believe that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

This is why we are looking for a PM to make Paradox a category-defining global brand loved for its product.

This is a full-time position from our beautiful offices in Dubai, Paris or Lisbon or remotely anywhere in the world.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox, we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can translate insight into transformation, through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche - a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

OUR AI-NATIVE AMBITION 🤖

We want to build an AI-native company, with agents in every department doing the work alongside our people.

In product, that means building a self-learning AI for product management: a system that learns from every user signal, experiment and release, and gets sharper at deciding what to build next.

For our clients, it means a self-learning AI that serves them through psychology and coaching, and gets better at helping each person change with every interaction.

You won’t just use AI tools: you’ll help design the agents, loops and feedback systems that make Paradox learn faster than anyone else.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

As Product Manager, you’ll be the architect of a new category, transforming growth into a living ecosystem powered by AI, behavioral science, and design.

You won’t just build features, you’ll craft experiences that rewire behavior.

You’re the architect bringing clarity between vision and execution, the person who turns “we should build this” into “it’s live, here’s the data and tangible impact.”

Every product cycle you lead will integrate:

  • Protocols : guided frameworks grounded in psychology that rewire perception, emotion, and action.

  • Pods : human connection, accountability, and shared rituals.

  • Loops : adaptive, AI-powered coaching cycles that evolve with each user.

  • Personalization : experiences that feel uniquely theirs, every time.

Going from a successful personal brand, to an international tech-driven iconic brand, is far from easy. It will be messy, chaotic - requiring constant iterations on MVPs and innovation in tech. Therefore to achieve this here are :

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

1. Make AI-native a way of building the company

  • Translate the founder’s strategic vision into a clear product strategy.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap that connects business goals, user outcomes, and technological innovation.

  • Ensure every feature supports the evolution of the Paradox ecosystem: Loops, PX Agents, Protocols, Membership.

2. User Understanding & Behavioral Insight

  • Be obsessed with user problems : talk to users weekly, analyze patterns, and identify where transformation breaks.

  • Turn insights from behavioral science, coaching psychology, and learning design into actionable product hypotheses.

  • Design loops, feedback, and rituals that make growth tangible.

  • build for both the heart (inspiration) and the brain (structure).

3. Build, Ship, Learn Fast, create AI Loops

  • Apply Lean Startup methodology and scientific thinking to validate ideas through MVPs, not opinions.

  • Design experiments and measurable success metrics before building.

  • Iterate on a weekly basis on new hypothesis

4. AI Native Product Analytics & Impact Measurement

  • Define and track product success metrics (activation, retention, transformation rates).

  • Connect data to business KPIs, know how your product drives lifetime value, not just engagement.

  • We don’t track metrics just for internal dashboards, we track them also to prove transformation.

  • Help marketing leverage this data to fuel authentic, evidence-based storytelling — showing the world what real transformation looks like.

5. Blend emotions (“open the heart of people”) with precision (“build loops, scoring, protocols”).

  • Create a visceral experience that translates into emotions of inspiration, awe from users.

  • Use a Science-backed, Cinematic, Contrarian style : Every product touchpoint should be grounded in behavioral science, expressed with cinematic beauty, and challenge conventions

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE 😍

Experience :

  • 3–6 years as a Product Manager / Product Owner in EdTech, SaaS, or Consumer Tech.

  • Bonus: experience in AI-driven products, learning design, or personal development platforms.

  • You’ve shipped at least one major feature or product end-to-end, and can show measurable results.

  • Uses Figma comfortably, prototypes directly.

Traits :

  • Craft-obsessed : You get things done, you love to work much beyond 9-5, you have a doer mentality, a bias for outcomes and want to be a beast in your field

  • User & Impact Obsessed: You think in outcomes, not outputs, you care about transformation.

  • Analytical & System Thinker: You can turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, metrics, and roadmap.

  • Digital & AI savvy : you’re able to build AI Agents (if not, you demonstrate ability to learn while applying).

  • Cross-disciplinary Curiosity: You speak both tech and human; You can move from vision to spreadsheet to Figma

Language

French : native

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Job Title: AI Engineer (Voice & Agentic Systems)
Location:Noida
Working Mode:Remote
Type:Full-time
Experience:2+ Years (shipping LLM agents)
About the Company:
weya AI builds AI automations - Voice, video and WhatsApp agents that banks, lenders and insurers put in front of their customers. Our agents handle collections, onboarding, renewals, KYC follow-ups and support calls at scale, across India, the Middle East & Africa, Australia and the US. We're a small team of 11-15 people. Every engineer ships to production, talks to customers, and owns real outcomes. If an agent mishandles a loan call, it costs a client money and trust, so we build for reliability first.
About the Role:
You'll design, build and run the agents that talk to our clients' customers: LLM orchestration with LlamaIndex/LangChain, FastAPI services behind them, and real-time voice pipelines wired into telephony providers. You own an agent end to end, from the first prompt to the 10,000th concurrent call.

What You'll Do?

  • Build agentic workflows with LlamaIndex and LangChain: tool calling, RAG over policy and loan documents, multi-step reasoning, and guardrails for regulated conversations.
  • Design and run FastAPI services that serve agents in real time: async endpoints, WebSockets, webhooks, background tasks and clean API contracts.
  • Build low-latency voice agents end to end: STT, LLM, TTS, voice activity detection, barge-in/interruption handling, and turn-taking.
  • Integrate and maintain telephony providers (e.g. Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage, SIP trunks): inbound/outbound calls, call transfer, recordings, DTMF, and media streaming.
  • Engineer for failure: provider outages, dropped calls, LLM timeouts, partial transcripts, retries and idempotency, so one bad dependency never takes down a campaign.
  • Write tests that catch problems before clients do: unit and integration tests, simulated calls, load tests, and regression suites for agent behaviour.
  • Instrument everything: latency per turn, call success rates, cost per call, and alerts that fire before a client notices.
  • Work directly with FDEs and clients to turn real call transcripts into better agents.

Requirements

What We're Looking For? (Non-Negotiable)
  • Agentic frameworks: shipped production agents with LlamaIndex and/or LangChain (or LangGraph), including tool use, memory and RAG. Not just notebooks.
  • FastAPI: extensive experience building async Python services with FastAPI, Pydantic, WebSockets and background workers, under real traffic.
  • Voice agents: built at least one voice agent that handled real customer calls, with hands-on work on STT/TTS providers (e.g. Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Azure, Google) and latency tuning.
  • Telephony: integrated two or more telephony providers or SIP setups, and can explain how audio flows from a phone network to your code and back.
  • Production mindset: you think about concurrency, rate limits, timeouts, retries and edge cases before writing the happy path, and you write tests for them.
  • Debugging under pressure: comfortable reading logs, call recordings and traces to find why a call failed.
  • Clear written English; able to explain a technical trade-off to a client.

Good to have (Bonus Points):

  • Real-time voice frameworks such as LiveKit Agents or Vapi, or speech-to-speech models.
  • Go for high-throughput services alongside Python.
  • Multilingual voice work, especially Hindi, Hinglish, Arabic or other Indic languages.
  • Experience in BFSI or other regulated domains: consent, call recording rules, PII handling, audit trails.
  • LLM evaluation: automated scoring of agent conversations, prompt regression testing.
  • WhatsApp Business API or video agent experience.
  • Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP, Redis, Postgres, and queues like Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Benefits

Get Real Experience on "What Success looks like?"
    To apply:send your CV , GitHub or a demo of a voice agent you built, and one paragraph
    on the hardest telephony problem you've solved. Open question: application email or link.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

  • Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

  • Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Why PermitFlow Wants You

This role is foundational. We are standing up a dedicated Account Management function so that every signed enterprise customer has one clear commercial owner. You'll own the commercial relationship for a portfolio of the largest builders, contractors, developers, and multi-brand home-services platforms in the country — protecting renewals, closing expansion, and turning signed agreements into compounding partnerships. Every one of those accounts gets a single, named commercial owner for the life of the relationship. That's you.

You carry a quota and own the number: renewals, upsell, cross-sell, new-product and business-unit expansion. Implementation owns onboarding and go-live, Ops owns the day-to-day operating cadence, and Customer Success owns account health and adoption. You own everything commercial from the moment an account clears its opt-out window, and you convert delivered value into retained and expanded revenue.

What You'll Do

  • Own the commercial relationship and a $6M+ enterprise book of business from the moment each account becomes a PermitFlow customer.

  • Lead every renewal end to end — strategy, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal, close

  • Build and close expansion pipeline across products, business units, geographies, brands, and volume tiers

  • Develop multi-year account plans, stakeholder maps, whitespace maps, and mutual commercial plans

  • Build trusted relationships from decision makers at both the regional an national level, including the C-suite and private-equity sponsors

  • Translate operational outcomes — time-to-permit, throughput, cost, and risk reduction — into executive-grade ROI narratives

  • Own renewal and expansion forecasting, CRM hygiene, next steps, and close plans

  • Partner tightly with Implementation, Ops, and Customer Success on onboarding, operating cadence, health, adoption, and risk signals while holding a clean commercial swim-lane

  • Help build the Account Management playbook — handoffs, tiering, cadences, forecasting, account-planning standards

  • ~20% Travel as needed for customer meetings, executive reviews, industry events (e.g. Pantheon), and portfolio-company HQ visits

Who You Are

  • Enterprise Commercial Leader: 8+ years in enterprise Account Management, expansion sales, or a comparable quota-carrying post-sale role

  • Self Starter: You’ve seen this show before and can help build the foundation of what this will look like as we continue to scale

  • Proven Revenue Owner: You have personally managed a $5M+ book and can show GRR, NRR, renewal, and expansion numbers

  • Complex Deal Operator: Comfortable with $200K+ ACV accounts, multi-threaded negotiations, procurement, security and legal reviews, and multi-entity rollouts

  • Seller, Not Just a Steward: You source, qualify, price, negotiate, and close expansion yourself — you don't hand it to Sales

  • Executive Relationship Builder: You're just as credible sitting across from a CFO as you are talking with a branch manager at a job site - warm, direct, curious, and plainspoken no matter who's in the room

  • Strategic and Analytical: You connect usage and outcomes to financial impact, risk, pricing, and a multi-year growth thesis

  • Forecast-Disciplined: Clear stages, close plans, renewal timelines, accurate commits

  • Cross-Functional Partner: You create clarity and momentum across Sales, CS, Product, Solutions, Support, Legal, Finance, and RevOps

  • Industry Knowledge: Construction-tech, PropTech, field-service software, home services, or another operationally complex vertical strongly preferred

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)

  • Expansion ARR closed, and expansion pipeline coverage, win rate, and velocity

  • Renewal rate and renewal/expansion forecast accuracy

  • Account, brand, geography, and product penetration

  • Quality of executive relationships, account plans, and cross-functional execution

  • Contribution to a repeatable Account Management operating model

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary, uncapped commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking an experienced Category Manager, Electronics to lead strategic sourcing for electronic and electromechanical components across Re Manufacturing's family of companies. In this role, you will develop sourcing strategies, build supplier partnerships, and help ensure our businesses have reliable access to the components they need to support manufacturing operations and continued growth.

You bring a strong background in strategic sourcing, category management, and supplier negotiations, ideally within electronics or advanced manufacturing. You understand how to balance cost, quality, lead times, and supply chain risk while developing long-term relationships with manufacturers and distributors. You're comfortable navigating complex supplier agreements, analyzing data, and collaborating with engineering, operations, and business leaders to make informed sourcing decisions.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a critical sourcing category, influence supply chain strategy across multiple businesses, and help shape how Re approaches procurement. You'll also collaborate with our Digital and AI teams to explore how automation and emerging technologies can improve sourcing decisions, supplier performance, and overall efficiency.

What You Get To Do

  • Develop and lead the long-term sourcing strategy for electronic and electromechanical components, including wire and cable, connectors, terminals, sensors, printed circuit boards, and batteries.
  • Build and lead strategic relationships with component manufacturers and distributors to improve cost, quality, availability, lead times, and supply chain flexibility.
  • Lead supplier negotiations and establish long-term agreements covering pricing, delivery commitments, inventory programs, and commercial terms.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce costs, improve supply continuity, and mitigate supplier and contractual risks across Re businesses.
  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to develop sourcing solutions for specialized components, long-lead materials, and evolving manufacturing requirements.
  • Evaluate sourcing strategies involving SKU rationalization, minimum order quantities (MOQs), tooling investments, and non-recurring engineering (NRE) costs.
  • Establish and monitor supplier performance metrics, including on-time delivery, material availability, and inventory efficiency, to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate across functions, including Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Supply Chain, to align sourcing strategies with business priorities.
  • Explore AI and automation opportunities in partnership with Re's Digital and AI teams to improve supplier selection, sourcing decisions, and working capital management.
  • Provide strategic guidance on electronics sourcing initiatives, helping business leaders make informed decisions that support long-term growth.

What You Bring To The Team

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or category management, preferably with electronic or electromechanical components.
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Experience developing category strategies, negotiating contracts, and building strong supplier partnerships.
  • Knowledge of electronic components, including wire and cable, connectors, printed circuit boards, sensors, or similar products.
  • Ability to evaluate supplier performance, manage supply chain risks, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Experience with ERP systems, contract management tools, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Ability to balance competing priorities, solve problems, and drive results in a dynamic environment.
  • Interest in using AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve sourcing processes.
  • Willingness to travel domestically 10–25% as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading electronics categories, including wire harness components, connectors, printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), or other specialized electromechanical components.
  • Experience in regulated manufacturing environments, particularly aerospace, defense, or government contracting.
  • Familiarity with FAR/DFARS, ITAR/EAR, and contractual flow-down requirements.
  • Master's degree or MBA.
  • Professional certifications such as CSCP, CPIM, or CPSM.

The base salary range for this position is $120,000 – $180,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at or you may call us at 617.909.6275.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Join Instacart as a Bilingual Customer Experience T3 Specialist, where you’ll play a key role in supporting the delivery experience for pharmacy orders and contributing to our mission of empowering healthier living. As part of a dedicated team, you’ll help create seamless, empathetic, and impactful interactions that enhance our customers’ trust and satisfaction with Instacart’s services.

We are currently seeking a Bilingual Customer Experience T3 Specialist to join our team. In this role, you’ll be the voice of Instacart, delivering exceptional service through real-time calls and occasionally emails. You’ll work directly with customers, shoppers, pharmacists, and retail partners to create personalized support experiences that reflect empathy, kindness, and professionalism. Your work will focus on ensuring customer satisfaction by supporting Instacart Health initiatives like Fresh Funds and delivery-related inquiries for Rx orders, helping users during the moments that matter most.

The Instacart Customer Experience Consumer Vanguard team is dedicated to supporting a range of interactions across our customer, shopper, retailer, and partner community. From assisting with inquiries about Fresh Funds under our Instacart Health initiative to supporting Rx customers with prescription delivery and related questions, we provide empathetic and solutions-focused service. Whether resolving app issues or troubleshooting delivery concerns, our team is committed to advocating on behalf of our users and creating exceptional support experiences that contribute to Instacart’s vision of accessible and reliable services for all.

About the Job

  • Take ownership of delivering real-time support to customers with a focus on Rx delivery-related inquiries and Instacart Health programs like Fresh Funds.
  • Leverage exceptional problem-solving skills to provide fast, effective resolutions while navigating complex and evolving challenges at scale.

  • Comfort and proficiency with technology, from navigating web-based support platforms to using and troubleshooting smartphone apps (iPhone/Android).

  • Experience in delivery-focused customer support, particularly within delivery apps
  • Familiarity with handling inbound customer service calls and/or working within HIPAA-compliant environments.
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, metrics-driven contact center setting.
  • Proficiency with customer support tools like Salesforce, Geneys, Admin or similar platforms.

raw.description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

What You’ll Need

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills — comfortable on the phone, able to explain complex terms simply, and skilled at advocating for your client while preserving relationships.
  • Proven ability to transact at high volume, stay organized, and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.
  • High ownership mindset and comfort working cross-functionally to resolve issues (title, inspections, HOA, lender, internal ops, etc.).

About the Role

At Opendoor, we’re rebuilding how people buy and sell homes, with more certainty, more choice, and less friction in the most important financial decision of their lives. Opendoor 2.0 is about focus, execution, and delivering real value for homeowners and those striving to become homeowners.

Our Resale Listing Partners are licensed real estate professionals who serve as the single point of contact with buyer’s agents from offer through close on Opendoor-owned homes. They negotiate on behalf of our seller (Opendoor), coordinate with internal teams and title partners, and drive smooth, on-time closings while delivering a standout agent and buyer experience.

We’re building a remote Listing Partner team in Georgia for professionals with an active Georgia real estate license. As a Listing Partner, you’ll focus on learning our playbook, mastering our tools, and building strong negotiation and communication skills. You’ll be supported with training, clear processes, and coaching so you can ramp into handling a high volume of listings and contracts with confidence.

What You’ll Do

  • Own offer-to-close communications with buyer’s agents on assigned Opendoor listings, serving as their primary point of contact throughout the transaction.
  • Negotiate offers and terms (price, concessions, repairs, timelines) within Opendoor guidelines to balance conversion, margin, and customer experience.
  • Oversee transactions to close by deadline through coordinating with internal teams (pricing, homes/renovations, transaction coordinators, title/escrow, brokerage) and external partners to clear issues and keep files moving.
  • Manage repair negotiations by reviewing inspection reports, leveraging our internal tools and workflows, and presenting clear, data-backed counters to buyer’s agents.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation in our internal systems (offer details, counter terms, repair decisions, key milestones) so others can quickly understand the status of each file.
  • Monitor portfolio health for your assigned listings, paying special attention to long-DOM homes and higher-risk transactions, and escalating when additional support or strategy is needed.
  • Deliver excellent agent and buyer experiences through proactive communication, expectation setting, and timely follow-up via phone, email, and text.
  • Adopt and champion new tools and processes (e.g., negotiation models, automation, AI-powered workflows, TC support) designed to increase both your productivity and deal quality.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Active real estate salesperson license in any state (or ability to obtain within a defined timeline prior to start date, subject to business needs and brokerage requirements).
  • Experience listing and/or selling homes.
  • Experience in residential real estate (e.g., listing agent, buyer’s agent, transaction coordinator, or similar client-facing role), or directly transferable experience in high-volume negotiations or transaction management.
  • Familiarity with MLS, transaction management platforms, and CRM tools.
  • Prior experience working in a centralized or inside sales environment (phone- and email-heavy).
  • Comfort using data and tooling (reports, dashboards, AI/automation) to inform decisions and prioritize your time.

How We Work

  • Schedule: Full-time, with flexibility needed for peak volume periods; weekend coverage is required.
  • Collaboration: You’ll work closely with other Listing Partners, Transaction Coordinators, Pricing, Homes, Title & Escrow, and Brokerage to create a seamless end-to-end experience.
  • Performance: We look at a balanced scorecard including conversion, fallthroughs, negotiation outcomes, title attach, pend-to-close time, and customer experience, with coaching and support to help you grow over time.

Why Join Opendoor

  • Opportunity to be part of an evolving resale team that is core to Opendoor’s strategy and growth.
  • Performance-based incentive pay aligned to outcomes you directly influence.
  • Training, tools, and coaching to help you advance to higher levels of impact and responsibility.
  • Benefits package including health coverage and other company programs (details provided during the interview process).

Closing Statement

About Opendoor
Founded in 2014, Opendoor’s mission is to power life’s progress one move at a time. We believe the traditional real estate process is broken and our goal is simple: build a digital, end-to-end customer experience that makes buying and selling a home simple and certain.

  • To learn how we are reinventing the real estate industry check out our website.
  • Hear about our culture directly from team members by visiting The Muse.
  • Discover what we are building for our customers by reading our blog.

Opendoor Values

Openness

We believe that being open about who we are and what we do allows us to be better.

Individuals seeking employment at Opendoor are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

raw.description:
At NVIDIA, we are at the forefront of innovation in AI, accelerated computing, and networking. Our work is redefining industries from healthcare and automotive to telecommunications. In this role, you will build and grow NVIDIA's engagement with the global Telco, 6G, and AI-native RAN developer ecosystem, working directly with partners, universities, research institutes, and industry innovators to advance next-generation wireless networks through applied research, hands-on prototyping, and ecosystem development.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in 6G, AI-native RAN, and wireless research. Serve as the trusted technical advisor, problem solver, and champion for the developer ecosystem in Telco, 6G, and AI-native RAN, with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies.
  • Accelerate critical workloads by demonstrating and integrating the NVIDIA software stack (tools, libraries, SDKs, NIMs, and blueprints) into partner products, platforms, and pipelines.
  • Guide partners through onboarding and integration by providing technical resources—such as sample code, guides, and demo pipelines—to accelerate 6G/AI-RAN-specific adoption and foster co-innovation of next-generation solutions.
  • Map and monitor the developer ecosystem to identify growth opportunities, collaborating with engineering, product management, and marketing to inform roadmaps and optimize partner adoption strategies.
  • Engage partner technical leaders to drive best-practice integrations and resolve technical challenges, using regular syncs to track adoption, surface new workflows, and channel critical field insights back to NVIDIA product teams.
  • Establish trusted relationships with leading universities, research institutes, faculty, principal investigators, graduate students, and applied research labs working on 6G, AI-RAN, wireless AI, and accelerated computing; connect their work with NVIDIA platforms, software, research, and product roadmaps.
  • Build hands-on proof-of-concepts and reference prototypes for AI-native RAN—including simulation, algorithm development, model training and inference, system integration, benchmarking, and experimental validation including over the air testing—enabling researchers to adopt NVIDIA technologies through reproducible code, notebooks, sample applications, and technical guides.
  • Represent NVIDIA in academic conferences, technical workshops, 3GPP-related forums, and the AI-RAN Alliance; develop technical contributions and cultivate partnerships across the global 6G research and standards community.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 10+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architect, or product management, including 5+ years of direct hands-on experience in wireless communications, Radio Access Network (RAN) architecture, advanced algorithm development, or applied AI research—including experience working with universities, research institutes, or collaborative research programs.
  • Proven experience leading, partnering, and scaling developer programs at major technology companies, and Telco/6G/AI-RAN ISVs, or within relevant verticals.
  • Significant technical depth in Telco and wireless communications software including AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), wireless simulation environments (MATLAB, Python-based simulators, software-defined radio, over the air RAN testbeds), GPU-accelerated computing, and RAN software stacks, and contributions to product integrations and software libraries.
  • Experience leading technical collaborations with engineering and product teams—including architectural design, code reviews, technical mentorship, and delivery of technical talks or workshops.
  • Proven ability to structure and implement complex technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal or external collaborators (across sales, legal, product, or marketing teams as needed).
  • Skilled at distilling complex technical concepts for audiences from engineers to executives, with end-to-end experience in defining, integrating, building, and jointly marketing solutions with strategic ISV partners.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing vertical-specific solutions (e.g., network stacks, AI-native RAN algorithms, PHY-layer signal processing pipelines, or end-to-end 5G/6G RAN prototype systems).
  • Familiarity with advanced computing, AI, and/or GPU acceleration platforms (CUDA, Aerial SDK, TensorRT, NeMo, cuBLAS, or other NVIDIA frameworks relevant to AI-native wireless and accelerated RAN).
  • Successful history of building and scaling developer communities and delivering impactful technical enablement programs.
  • Expertise in building frameworks to capture developer sentiment and market shifts, translating real-time ecosystem dynamics into actionable intelligence for Telco/6G/AI-RAN industry strategy and product rationalization.
  • Published IEEE or ACM research, 3GPP contributions, or recognized technical leadership in AI for wireless or AI-native RAN; established relationships and engagement across the global 6G research ecosystem including universities, government-funded research programs, and industry consortia such as the AI-RAN Alliance and O-RAN Alliance.

If you're eager to contribute to crafting the future of telecommunications and meet the above qualifications, we’d love to hear from you. Submit your application and join NVIDIA as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

raw.excerpt: deine aufgaben: • Compliance & Governance: Du entwickelst unsere Compliance- und Governance-Strukturen eigenverantwortlich weiter und sorgst für die Umsetzung und Überwachung relevanter Compliance-Maßnahmen.
raw.description:
deine aufgaben:

  • Compliance & Governance: Du entwickelst unsere Compliance- und Governance-Strukturen eigenverantwortlich weiter und sorgst für die Umsetzung und Überwachung relevanter Compliance-Maßnahmen.
  • Risikomanagement: Du verantwortest das Compliance-Risikomanagement: Du identifizierst, bewertest und überwachst Compliance-Risiken und entwickelst Maßnahmen zu deren Minimierung. Dabei wirkst du an der Weiterentwicklung unseres unternehmensweiten Risikomanagements und internen Kontrollsystems (IKS) mit und arbeitest eng mit den Prozessverantwortlichen zusammen. Zusätzlich führst du Compliance-Risikobewertungen von Dienstleistern und Geschäftspartnern durch und koordinierst die erforderlichen Maßnahmen mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.
  • Datenschutz & AI Governance: Du bearbeitest datenschutzrechtliche Compliance-Fragestellungen in Abstimmung mit unserer Datenschutzfunktion und wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Governance-Strukturen mit.
  • Schnittstellen & Audits: Du arbeitest eng mit Legal, Quality Management (QM), unserem Information Security Officer (ISB) und den technischen Fachbereichen zusammen und unterstützt bei Compliance-relevanten Aspekten interner und externer Audits sowie Zertifizierungen.
  • Monitoring & Beratung: Du entwickelst Compliance-Monitoring und Reporting weiter, bereitest Risiken und Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management auf und berätst die Fachbereiche bei Compliance-Fragestellungen.

das bist du:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Rechtswissenschaften, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit relevantem Compliance-Schwerpunkt.
  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Compliance, Governance oder Risikomanagement mit, idealerweise fünf Jahre oder mehr, vorzugsweise in einem SaaS-Unternehmen oder technologieorientierten Umfeld.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung mit Compliance- und Governance-Strukturen, Risikomanagement und internen Kontrollsystemen.
  • Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse der DSGVO und praktische Erfahrung mit datenschutzrechtlichen Bewertungen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Auftragsverarbeitung, internationalen Datentransfers und Datenschutzrisiken.
  • Eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation oder Zertifizierung als Datenschutzbeauftragte (DSB) ist ein besonderer Pluspunkt, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Informationssicherheit, IT-Compliance und relevante Standards wie ISO 27001 mit. Erfahrungen im Bereich AI Governance sind von Vorteil.
  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Remote First:Ob Homeoffice, deutschlandweite Coworking Spaces oder moderne Zentrale in Köln – wir decken alle Arbeitsformen ab.
Gut ausgestattet:Damit es dir im Homeoffice an nichts fehlt, stellen wir die passende Hardware zur Verfügung. Nach der Probezeit erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für ergonomisches Arbeiten von zu Hause.
Flexibilität:Bei uns kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten: Mit einer Kernarbeitszeit von 9:00 bis 12:00 Uhr hast du Freiraum, um Beruf und Privatleben entspannt zu vereinen. Mit unserem Workation Worldwide Programm kannst du bis zu 60 Arbeitstage im Jahr ortsunabhängig arbeiten – jetzt weltweit innerhalb von ±4 Stunden zur deutschen Zeitzone.
Benefits à la carte:Mit Probonio gestaltest du deine Benefits jeden Monat neu: Nutze dein Budget für Essenszuschüsse, Kita-Zuschüsse, Gutscheine oder buche dein Urban Sports Club Abo – ganz flexibel per App.
Erholung & Auszeit: Du profitierst von 32 Tagen bezahltem Urlaub pro Jahr. Zusätzlich sind Heiligabend und Silvester bei uns komplett arbeitsfrei. Mit unserem Culture Day kannst du dir außerdem einen Tag freinehmen, der dir persönlich wichtig ist – ganz bewusst und individuell.
Unternehmensweiter Bonus: Unser Shared Success Plan fördert den gemeinsamen Fokus auf unsere Ziele, indem wir den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens transparent und fair mit allen teilen.
Mobilität & Nachhaltigkeit:Über FINN JobAuto kannst du dein eigenes E-Fahrzeug zu attraktiven Konditionen leasen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von Bikeleasing.
Teamgeist:Unsere Teams treffen sich einmal im Tertial persönlich zu Brainstorming, Workshops und natürlich zu unseren beliebten Sommer- und Winterfeiern.
Gesund im Job:Wir unterstützen dich mit Urban Sports Club, Life Coaching Programmen und weiteren Angeboten, damit du fit und stressfrei durch den Arbeitsalltag kommst.
Dog-Friendly Headquarters:Dein vierbeiniger Freund ist im Büro herzlich willkommen -- bring deinen Hund einfach mit zur Arbeit!

This role will oversee the entire candidate experience from lead sourcing, interviewing and ultimately hiring candidates in concert with talent acquisition initiatives that support delivering the MasTec’s strategic priorities. Identify and stay current on market trends in the marketplace that impact ability to recruit. Location: This position is open to remote but preference will go to someone in the Fargo, ND or Dallas, TX office. Company Overview MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor). We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry. The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Investing App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in the Japan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

As Sr. Manager of Qualified Success Architecture, you will lead a team of Success Architects who get customers live, adopted, and renewed on Qualified. You report to the Director of Qualified Success Architecture, and you partner with them to turn strategy into consistent, high-quality delivery across your team’s customers.


You will be the senior escalation point and trusted advisor for your team’s most strategic accounts, and a working partner to your counterparts in Product, Sales, Marketing, and Salesforce account teams.


This is a player-coach seat. You will build and coach a strong team, and you will also step into the room when a customer’s rollout, QBR, or renewal needs senior technical leadership. You will be the voice of what customers really need, and you will earn credibility by being close to the work.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Hire, onboard, and develop Success Architects within the approved hiring plan. Raise the bar with every hire.
  • Coach for growth. Build clear career paths, and retain top performers by giving them stretch work, visibility, and a reason to stay.
  • Run the team’s operating rhythm: capacity, account assignments, risk reviews, and pipeline of renewals and expansions.
  • Model the culture: curious, accountable, customer-obsessed, and fun to work with.
  • Personally manage 2 to 5 of the team’s highest-need accounts, including those that are at risk, large, or complex.
  • Ensure your team executes the Qualified Implementation Framework consistently, and bring back what you learn so it keeps improving.
  • Guide strategic customers through architecture, data model, and rollout alongside the Enterprise Architects who run their stack.
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level Quarterly Business Reviews that tie Qualified to customer revenue goals.
  • Own adoption, health, and renewal outcomes for your team’s book. Know every at-risk account before it knows itself.
  • Turn successful customers into advocates through case studies, testimonials, and speaking moments, working hand in hand with Marketing.
  • Give the Director a clear, current view of customer health, renewal risk, and expansion opportunity for your team.
  • Recommend changes to team design, capacity, and investment based on what you see in the book.
  • Build and sustain executive relationships across Salesforce and our customers.
  • Co-plan with Salesforce teams on joint customers, joint pipeline, and joint wins.
  • Engage in internal product discussions, bringing customer feedback into actionable insights to help shape the product roadmap

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of Mid Market/Enterprise software experience
  • 1+ year of people management experience
  • Bachelors Degree required
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong individual contributors.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, persuasion, presentation and writing skills
  • You command a room, from a customer's CMO to a Salesforce executive.
  • Deep working knowledge of Salesforce CRM
  • Deep working knowledge of Qualified
  • Working knowledge of marketing automation systems
  • Knowledge in web / scripting technologies, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and SaaS applications
  • Outstanding problem-solving skills, including the ability to meet a business requirement with a technical solution
  • Must be willing to work in a fast-paced startup environment with multiple roles
  • Passion for making customers successful with software solutions

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits.
