raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

This is a remote position.

HR Coordinator — Project-Based, Part-Time, US Hours (Recruiting, Onboarding & HR Admin)

Remote | Philippines | Part-Time, 20 hrs/week | Within 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT, Tue–Sat (8 AM – 5 PM Pacific, Mon–Fri) | Project-Based Remote Role |PHP 20K - 27K max/ monthly

If you’re a high-performing HR professional who is discreet by default, closes every open item on a checklist, and knows exactly when to escalate, and you want to work with a mission-driven US-based sustainability consulting firm that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading.

This isn’t a role for a “form filler” who waits to be reminded, or someone who guesses on sensitive matters instead of asking.

This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll keep HR operations running across the full employee lifecycle, accurately and on time, so senior HR staff can spend their time on decisions, employee relations and recruiting quality.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with the HR team of a mission-driven, US-based sustainability consulting firm who:

  • Champions Innovation: Runs a modern HR stack (Rippling, JazzHR, Trainual) and welcomes AI-assisted drafting, as long as confidential data stays protected.
  • Values Your Growth: Gives you access to an AI-enabled operator community and a dedicated Success Manager (CSM) coaching you through your first 90 days.
  • Respects Your Expertise: Wants you to become the default owner of routine HR admin, with senior HR reviewing your work rather than redoing it, and is open to your improvements to templates, checklists and reminder flows.
  • Provides Clear Guidance: You’ll sit inside an established HR team led by a Director of HR and an HR Manager, so there’s always a clear escalation path.
  • Offers Real Breadth: A genuine HR operations seat covering recruiting, onboarding, training, benefits, leave, performance and offboarding, with hands-on exposure to US HR practice.

You’ll get career transformation, hands-on US HR experience, and the trust to own HR operations end to end, without being stuck in a “data entry only” rut.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core HR operations role covering employee records, onboarding and offboarding, recruiting coordination, and training and programme administration. You aren’t just processing forms; you’re the person who makes sure every request is routed, every record is right, and every checklist is closed, while treating employee data as confidential at every step.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • HR Inbox & Request Routing: Owning day-to-day triage of the HR and recruiting inboxes, routing routine items within one business day and escalating sensitive matters quickly and discreetly to the right person.
  • Employee Records Accuracy: Processing record updates in Rippling within agreed turnaround times, then running a records completeness check and resolving every gap you find.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding Coordination: Running checklists end to end: new-hire and leaver communications, background checks, orientation and exit interview scheduling, and document tracking, with nothing left open past its deadline.
  • Recruiting Coordination: Scheduling interviews, sending candidate communications and tracking assessments in JazzHR for assigned roles, with candidate updates going out within one business day.
  • Training & Programme Administration: Administering harassment prevention training, performance review and survey cycles, and mentorship programmes, and keeping Trainual content current.
  • Benefits, Leave & HR Resources: Handling benefits and leave filing and keeping HR resources up to date for employees.
  • Process Improvement: Improving at least one template, checklist or reminder flow and getting it adopted by the team.

Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Have Real HR Admin Experience: You’ve worked in HR, recruiting or people-ops administration, ideally supporting a US team.
  • Are a Confidential Recordkeeper: You keep employee records accurate and complete, follow access rules without being reminded, and spot missing or inconsistent data before it causes a problem.
  • Close the Loop: You’ve run onboarding, offboarding or recruiting steps end to end, and you track every open item to closure, not just the first step.
  • Know When to Ask: You understand the limits of your authority and escalate sensitive or unfamiliar matters instead of guessing.
  • Write Clearly: Your instructions, reminders and candidate emails are clear enough that people act on them the first time.
  • Are Comfortable in HR Systems: You’ve worked in an HRIS and an applicant tracking system, and you use AI to speed up drafting while protecting confidential data.
  • Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.
  • Communicate with Professional Confidence: You’re comfortable working in writing and on calls with US-based employees, candidates and HR leaders.
  • Can Commit to the Schedule: You can reliably work 20 hours a week within US Pacific business hours.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Rippling, JazzHR, Trainual, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams or Slack, and Monday.com or ClickUp.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • Nothing Slips Through the Inbox: HR and recruiting requests are routed or actioned within one business day, and sensitive items reach the right person every time.
  • Records Are Clean: Record updates are current with no backlog, and the completeness check is done with every gap resolved.
  • Joiners and Leavers Are Seamless: You run onboarding and offboarding checklists independently, with zero items outstanding past deadline.
  • Programmes Hit Target: A training, performance review or survey cycle is completed to target, and Trainual content is up to date.
  • Trust Is Earned: You’re the default owner of routine HR admin, senior HR reviews rather than redoes your work, and at least one of your process improvements has been adopted.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m organised, discreet and I finish what I start. I just want an HR team that trusts me with the whole employee lifecycle and gives me clear guidance when it matters.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs
across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across
teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results.
At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements,
work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns.
You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into

repeatable delivery models.

Responsibilities:

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership
• Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that
span multiple teams and workstreams.
• Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional
requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes.
• Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns.
• Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a
cohesive end-to-end architecture.
• Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and
code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse.
• Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces,
testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable.
• Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help
teams adopt effective practices at program scale.
Delivery and Consulting Excellence
• Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into
integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies.
• Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and
explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.
• Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences,
including executives.
• Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape
modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest.
• Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable
delivery and stable team velocity.
• Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies
are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery.
• Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep
3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones.
• Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable
incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry
and feedback.
• Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to
clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple,

direct language.

Mentorship and Team Development:

  • Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural
    judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.
    • Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making
    and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified.
    • Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and
    mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects.

Growth and Innovation:

  • Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment
    across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them.
    • Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify
    opportunities to provide additional business value.
    • Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision,
    contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.
    • Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting
    assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction.
    • Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter
    repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
    • Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AIassisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
    • Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help
    build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
    • 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams,
    including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
    • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, including 4+ years of experience architecting data
    solutions on Azure.
    • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure with experience with Databricks and/or Fabric.
    • Proven ability to design and implement modern data architectures (data lakes, data warehouses,
    lakehouses, data mesh, streaming pipelines).
    • Proficiency in Python, PySpark, SQL, and data engineering frameworks.
    • Azure DevOps (including building Stories and tasks, and using pipelines and ARM templates for
    publishing code).
    • Knowledge of infrastructure as code, APIs, security, compliance, and master data management.
    • Experience optimizing data pipelines, queries, and architectures for performance and cost.
    • Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as
    modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs.
    • Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and
    solid delivery practices.
    • Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable
    delivery across time zones.
    • Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary
    domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale.
    • Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into
    solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services.
    • Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and
    dependency handling.
    • Experience in consulting or professional services.
    • Familiarity with key Azure services relevant to your domain, such as messaging, compute, data,
    security, networking, and integration.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication.
    • Demonstrated interest in learning new cloud technologies and turning that learning into practical
    improvements for teams.
    • Ability to stay hands-on with architecture and, when needed, implementation while guiding complex

cloud solutions across teams.

with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Overview

We’re hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Strategist to own demand generation for our marketing and leasing solutions. This role is designed for a marketer who blends strategic thinking with strong execution and knows how to turn complex product capabilities into clear, compelling campaigns that drive pipeline and sales momentum. This is a strategic, hands-on role for a marketer who thrives at the intersection of creative storytelling, cross-channel orchestration, and data-driven performance optimization.

As the Senior Growth Marketing Strategist, you will lead the end-to-end strategy and execution of integrated, multi-channel campaigns aligned to product launches, sales priorities, and key buyer personas across the multifamily market. You’ll be responsible for translating product narratives into campaign themes, orchestrating activation across paid and owned channels, and continuously optimizing performance using data and insights.

This role sits at the center of Marketing, Product Marketing, and Sales. Success requires strong cross-functional alignment, clear communication, and the ability to balance creativity with rigor and accountability.

About Realpage: At Realpage, we believe better technology creates stronger communities. For over 25 years, we’ve partnered with multifamily housing operators and property management companies to simplify operations, improve efficiency, and unlock new growth opportunities.

Trusted across the rental housing industry, Realpage delivers property management software, smart AI-driven tools, and industry-leading data and insights that help companies streamline leasing, optimize property and financial performance, and enhance the resident experience.

Our mission is simple: empower property management companies to operate more efficiently, serve residents more effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving rental housing market.

Responsibilities

  • Own integrated campaign strategy and execution for marketing and leasing products, focused on pipeline creation and deal acceleration.
  • Design full-funnel, multi-touch campaigns aligned to personas, verticals, and stages of the buyer journey across paid media, email, web, events, outbound SDR support and content syndication.
  • Partner closely with Product Marketing to translate product positioning and narratives into clear value propositions, campaign themes, and audience-specific messaging.
  • Develop campaign messaging frameworks, content outlines, nurture cadences, and creative briefs tailored to segmented audiences.
  • Collaborate with SEO, web development, paid media, creative, and marketing operations to activate campaigns consistently across all touchpoints.
  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate results and insights to stakeholders.
  • Align with Sales leaders and SDR teams to ensure campaign readiness, clear handoffs, and effective feedback loops that improve conversion.
  • Stay current on evolving demand generation best practices, AI-driven marketing tools, and emerging content formats.
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to Product Marketing and Sales, contributing ideas that improve scale, efficiency, and impact.

Qualifications

Required:

raw.description:
See your work in a new light.

At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux—meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

We’re looking for a Patient Access Liaison (PAL) – Active who wants their work to mean something — someone who brings empathy, precision, and follow‑through to protecting patients’ ongoing access to care.

Compensation:$23.00 to $30.00 per hour, based on experience
Location: Remote
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM CST or EST

Why This Role Matters

The PAL – Active plays a critical role in ensuring patients do not experience interruptions in therapy due to insurance or benefit changes. By proactively monitoring eligibility and authorization status, this role helps remove barriers before they impact patient care.

In this role, your work will:

  • Help patients remain on therapy without delays or disruption
  • Provide clarity and reassurance during insurance or coverage changes
  • Support care teams through accurate documentation and proactive communication

Every follow‑up helps safeguard a patient’s ability to continue treatment with confidence.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor monthly insurance eligibility and authorization status for assigned active patients
  • Review CareTend queues and ensure all authorizations are current and on file before service delivery
  • Identify coverage changes and work directly with patients, sales teams, and physicians to obtain updated insurance or clinical documentation
  • Notify Reimbursement Specialists when new benefits verification or prior authorizations are required
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients, providers, and field partners, answering benefits and authorization questions as they arise
  • Collaborate closely with reimbursement, nurse coordination, pharmacy operations, and data entry teams to keep cases moving forward
  • Communicate potential delays proactively to downstream teams
  • Document all patient, provider, and internal communications accurately in systems of record
  • Track referral status, volume, and workload metrics to organize daily activities and meet service goals
  • Support PAL‑Pending duties as needed to ensure intake coverage and continuity

What We’re Looking For

You may be a great fit if you bring:

  • 1–3 years of experience supporting patient referrals, prescription services, or reimbursement in infusion or specialty therapies
  • Experience delivering high‑quality customer service to patients and healthcare providers
  • Familiarity with electronic health records or pharmacy patient management systems
  • Proficiency in medical or pharmacy terminology
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Moderate proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor’s degree preferred)
  • Willingness to travel up to 5% as needed

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience supporting prescribers, patients, and field teams in infusion or specialty therapy environments
  • General understanding of insurance benefits, payer requirements, and verification processes
  • Familiarity with infusion therapy workflows and patient needs

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe care deserves more light — more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

Here, you’ll find:

  • Purpose‑driven work with direct patient impact
  • A patient‑first, collaborative intake environment
  • Close partnership with clinical, reimbursement, and pharmacy teams
  • Opportunities to grow your expertise while supporting meaningful care journeys

Come help protect patient access to infusion care — and see what’s possible when care comes first.

Pay Range/Rate
$23—$30 USD

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those required for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact the LUX Infusion Talent Team at or 954.385.7322 x 1425.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, or sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee may also be required to occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Employees are expected to:

  • Participate annually in required legal and ethical compliance training
  • Consistently act in compliance with LUX Infusion’s legal, ethical, and compliance policies
  • Adhere to all standards and procedures outlined in the LUX Infusion Compliance Manual
  • Refrain from any behavior that could be considered unethical or unlawful

EXPECTATIONS FOR ALL EMPLOYEES

All LUX Infusion team members are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision, and values by demonstrating integrity, dedication, compassion, and enthusiasm. This includes placing patients first, working collaboratively with a “stacked‑hands” mindset, and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

GENERAL INFORMATION

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals in this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

This role operates in a fast‑paced environment and requires the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage multiple tasks effectively, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Employees in this position may be required to assist directly - or coordinate appropriate assistance - to ensure access to LUX Infusion’s services for individuals with disabilities, including patients, visitors, employees, or others.

LUX Infusion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

What You’ll Need

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills — comfortable on the phone, able to explain complex terms simply, and skilled at advocating for your client while preserving relationships.
  • Proven ability to transact at high volume, stay organized, and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.
  • High ownership mindset and comfort working cross-functionally to resolve issues (title, inspections, HOA, lender, internal ops, etc.).

About the Role

At Opendoor, we’re rebuilding how people buy and sell homes, with more certainty, more choice, and less friction in the most important financial decision of their lives. Opendoor 2.0 is about focus, execution, and delivering real value for homeowners and those striving to become homeowners.

Our Resale Listing Partners are licensed real estate professionals who serve as the single point of contact with buyer’s agents from offer through close on Opendoor-owned homes. They negotiate on behalf of our seller (Opendoor), coordinate with internal teams and title partners, and drive smooth, on-time closings while delivering a standout agent and buyer experience.

We’re building a remote Listing Partner team in Georgia for professionals with an active Georgia real estate license. As a Listing Partner, you’ll focus on learning our playbook, mastering our tools, and building strong negotiation and communication skills. You’ll be supported with training, clear processes, and coaching so you can ramp into handling a high volume of listings and contracts with confidence.

What You’ll Do

  • Own offer-to-close communications with buyer’s agents on assigned Opendoor listings, serving as their primary point of contact throughout the transaction.
  • Negotiate offers and terms (price, concessions, repairs, timelines) within Opendoor guidelines to balance conversion, margin, and customer experience.
  • Oversee transactions to close by deadline through coordinating with internal teams (pricing, homes/renovations, transaction coordinators, title/escrow, brokerage) and external partners to clear issues and keep files moving.
  • Manage repair negotiations by reviewing inspection reports, leveraging our internal tools and workflows, and presenting clear, data-backed counters to buyer’s agents.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation in our internal systems (offer details, counter terms, repair decisions, key milestones) so others can quickly understand the status of each file.
  • Monitor portfolio health for your assigned listings, paying special attention to long-DOM homes and higher-risk transactions, and escalating when additional support or strategy is needed.
  • Deliver excellent agent and buyer experiences through proactive communication, expectation setting, and timely follow-up via phone, email, and text.
  • Adopt and champion new tools and processes (e.g., negotiation models, automation, AI-powered workflows, TC support) designed to increase both your productivity and deal quality.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Active real estate salesperson license in any state (or ability to obtain within a defined timeline prior to start date, subject to business needs and brokerage requirements).
  • Experience listing and/or selling homes.
  • Experience in residential real estate (e.g., listing agent, buyer’s agent, transaction coordinator, or similar client-facing role), or directly transferable experience in high-volume negotiations or transaction management.
  • Familiarity with MLS, transaction management platforms, and CRM tools.
  • Prior experience working in a centralized or inside sales environment (phone- and email-heavy).
  • Comfort using data and tooling (reports, dashboards, AI/automation) to inform decisions and prioritize your time.

How We Work

  • Schedule: Full-time, with flexibility needed for peak volume periods; weekend coverage is required.
  • Collaboration: You’ll work closely with other Listing Partners, Transaction Coordinators, Pricing, Homes, Title & Escrow, and Brokerage to create a seamless end-to-end experience.
  • Performance: We look at a balanced scorecard including conversion, fallthroughs, negotiation outcomes, title attach, pend-to-close time, and customer experience, with coaching and support to help you grow over time.

Why Join Opendoor

  • Opportunity to be part of an evolving resale team that is core to Opendoor’s strategy and growth.
  • Performance-based incentive pay aligned to outcomes you directly influence.
  • Training, tools, and coaching to help you advance to higher levels of impact and responsibility.
  • Benefits package including health coverage and other company programs (details provided during the interview process).

Closing Statement

About Opendoor
Founded in 2014, Opendoor’s mission is to power life’s progress one move at a time. We believe the traditional real estate process is broken and our goal is simple: build a digital, end-to-end customer experience that makes buying and selling a home simple and certain.

  • To learn how we are reinventing the real estate industry check out our website.
  • Hear about our culture directly from team members by visiting The Muse.
  • Discover what we are building for our customers by reading our blog.

Opendoor Values

Openness

We believe that being open about who we are and what we do allows us to be better.

Equal Opportunity
Individuals seeking employment at Opendoor are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

raw.description:
At NVIDIA, we are at the forefront of innovation in AI, accelerated computing, and networking. Our work is redefining industries from healthcare and automotive to telecommunications. In this role, you will build and grow NVIDIA's engagement with the global Telco, 6G, and AI-native RAN developer ecosystem, working directly with partners, universities, research institutes, and industry innovators to advance next-generation wireless networks through applied research, hands-on prototyping, and ecosystem development.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in 6G, AI-native RAN, and wireless research. Serve as the trusted technical advisor, problem solver, and champion for the developer ecosystem in Telco, 6G, and AI-native RAN, with cross-functional partners to drive adoption of NVIDIA technologies.
  • Accelerate critical workloads by demonstrating and integrating the NVIDIA software stack (tools, libraries, SDKs, NIMs, and blueprints) into partner products, platforms, and pipelines.
  • Guide partners through onboarding and integration by providing technical resources—such as sample code, guides, and demo pipelines—to accelerate 6G/AI-RAN-specific adoption and foster co-innovation of next-generation solutions.
  • Map and monitor the developer ecosystem to identify growth opportunities, collaborating with engineering, product management, and marketing to inform roadmaps and optimize partner adoption strategies.
  • Engage partner technical leaders to drive best-practice integrations and resolve technical challenges, using regular syncs to track adoption, surface new workflows, and channel critical field insights back to NVIDIA product teams.
  • Establish trusted relationships with leading universities, research institutes, faculty, principal investigators, graduate students, and applied research labs working on 6G, AI-RAN, wireless AI, and accelerated computing; connect their work with NVIDIA platforms, software, research, and product roadmaps.
  • Build hands-on proof-of-concepts and reference prototypes for AI-native RAN—including simulation, algorithm development, model training and inference, system integration, benchmarking, and experimental validation including over the air testing—enabling researchers to adopt NVIDIA technologies through reproducible code, notebooks, sample applications, and technical guides.
  • Represent NVIDIA in academic conferences, technical workshops, 3GPP-related forums, and the AI-RAN Alliance; develop technical contributions and cultivate partnerships across the global 6G research and standards community.

What We Need to See:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • A minimum of 10+ years of overall professional experience in the technology industry in software engineering, developer relations, technical partnerships, solutions architect, or product management, including 5+ years of direct hands-on experience in wireless communications, Radio Access Network (RAN) architecture, advanced algorithm development, or applied AI research—including experience working with universities, research institutes, or collaborative research programs.
  • Proven experience leading, partnering, and scaling developer programs at major technology companies, and Telco/6G/AI-RAN ISVs, or within relevant verticals.
  • Significant technical depth in Telco and wireless communications software including AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), wireless simulation environments (MATLAB, Python-based simulators, software-defined radio, over the air RAN testbeds), GPU-accelerated computing, and RAN software stacks, and contributions to product integrations and software libraries.
  • Experience leading technical collaborations with engineering and product teams—including architectural design, code reviews, technical mentorship, and delivery of technical talks or workshops.
  • Proven ability to structure and implement complex technical engagements, negotiate requirements, prioritize issues, and collaborate with internal or external collaborators (across sales, legal, product, or marketing teams as needed).
  • Skilled at distilling complex technical concepts for audiences from engineers to executives, with end-to-end experience in defining, integrating, building, and jointly marketing solutions with strategic ISV partners.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing vertical-specific solutions (e.g., network stacks, AI-native RAN algorithms, PHY-layer signal processing pipelines, or end-to-end 5G/6G RAN prototype systems).
  • Familiarity with advanced computing, AI, and/or GPU acceleration platforms (CUDA, Aerial SDK, TensorRT, NeMo, cuBLAS, or other NVIDIA frameworks relevant to AI-native wireless and accelerated RAN).
  • Successful history of building and scaling developer communities and delivering impactful technical enablement programs.
  • Expertise in building frameworks to capture developer sentiment and market shifts, translating real-time ecosystem dynamics into actionable intelligence for Telco/6G/AI-RAN industry strategy and product rationalization.
  • Published IEEE or ACM research, 3GPP contributions, or recognized technical leadership in AI for wireless or AI-native RAN; established relationships and engagement across the global 6G research ecosystem including universities, government-funded research programs, and industry consortia such as the AI-RAN Alliance and O-RAN Alliance.

If you're eager to contribute to crafting the future of telecommunications and meet the above qualifications, we’d love to hear from you. Submit your application and join NVIDIA as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
Overview In this role, the Talent Specialist II will support leadership with sourcing active and passive talent to meet hiring needs across departments and project/office locations, to achieve immediate and future staffing plans. This role will oversee the entire candidate experience from lead sourcing, interviewing and ultimately hiring candidates in concert with talent acquisition initiatives that support delivering the MasTec’s strategic priorities. Identify and stay current on market trends in the marketplace that impact ability to recruit. Location: This position is open to remote but preference will go to someone in the Fargo, ND or Dallas, TX office. Company Overview MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor). We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry. The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do. MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments. Recruitment Video: Responsibilities Essential Job Functions Provide talent acquisition solutions and market insight to meet business growth plans and drive key results Own and lead sourcing strategies that increase the volume of potential qualified candidates and build diverse pipelines. Influence and educate internal stakeholders on best practices, such as effective job descriptions, candidate outreach, employer value propositions, and excellent interview and onboarding experiences, to drive positive candidate experiences. Work with department leadership to create plans and identify resources for staffing needs Provide exceptional candidate experience, while managing the full recruitment lifecycle Participate in key projects that enhance internal recruitment process, focusing on immediate and longer-term needs Network through industry contacts, association memberships, trade groups, social media, and employees Serve as a representative to the the MasTec brand and culture to candidates and industry networks Build and maintain relationships with passive candidates and referrals Actively participate in career fairs, sourcing events and projects Collaborate with hiring managers and stakeholders regularly to keep parties informed, establish co-ownership, improve morale, and source new candidate leads Conduct regular follow-up with hiring managers to determine the effectiveness of recruiting plans and implementation Drive process improvements to help make the hiring process more effective, efficient, and positive for both hiring managers and candidates Create and negotiate offers with candidates that may include complex compensation, incentive plans, relocation packages or other hiring issues Liaise closely with internal functions such as HR, Resources & Logistics, IT, Marketing/Communications, and other business units as necessary to onboard candidates effectively Qualifications EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience Minimum of 3-5 years recruiting experience required with 3+ years within construction preferred KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED: In-depth knowledge of recruitment processes, with experience pipelining for future roles Ability to develop and maintain expertise and practical working knowledge EEO, AAP, and OFCCP requirements as applied in organizational sourcing Exceptional prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects at once Expertise and experience in latest recruitment trends, including the use of Social Media tools for recruitment Experience with iCIMS, UKG and/or Service Now is a plus Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Experience in a research capacity for candidate generation Experience managing and prioritizing multiple searches, projects, and relationships Strong attention to detail while operating with a high sense of urgency Strong sourcing, interviewing, and negotiation skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills along with a penchant towards metrics Experience recruiting talent in competitive markets Strong understanding and ability to recruit at all levels of the organization from entry level to executive Decisive ability to shift priorities and function effectively in a dynamic fast paced work culture Strong work ethic and ability to work with minimal supervision and guidance is essential Ability to interact and build strong relationships with all levels of management Ability to travel up to 25%, or as needed based on business demands What's in it for you: Financial Wellbeing Compensation $65k-$85k/ year, commensurate with experience Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase 401(k) with company match & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) Flexible spending account (Healthcare & Dependent care) Bonus Eligible Health & Wellness Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (plan choice) - coverage for spouse, domestic partner, and children Diabetes Management, Telehealth Coverage, Prescription Drug Plan, Pet Insurance, Weight Management Drug Discount Discounted National Gym Membership Network Family & Lifestyle Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave Military Leave, including Benefits Continuation Employee Assistance Program Planning for the Unexpected Short and long-term disability, life insurance, and accidental death & dismemberment Voluntary life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity coverage Emergency Travel Assistance Program Group legal plan Position may be subject to pre-employment screening, which may include background check and drug testing. Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to respond to individual requests regarding application status. Please log into your candidate profile for up-to-date information. MasTec, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Company's policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also MasTec's policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions. We do not ask prospective employees for information about credit cards or personal passwords, and it does not require applicants to purchase equipment or software. About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Investing App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in the Japan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

As Sr. Manager of Qualified Success Architecture, you will lead a team of Success Architects who get customers live, adopted, and renewed on Qualified. You report to the Director of Qualified Success Architecture, and you partner with them to turn strategy into consistent, high-quality delivery across your team’s customers.


You will be the senior escalation point and trusted advisor for your team’s most strategic accounts, and a working partner to your counterparts in Product, Sales, Marketing, and Salesforce account teams.


This is a player-coach seat. You will build and coach a strong team, and you will also step into the room when a customer’s rollout, QBR, or renewal needs senior technical leadership. You will be the voice of what customers really need, and you will earn credibility by being close to the work.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Hire, onboard, and develop Success Architects within the approved hiring plan. Raise the bar with every hire.
  • Coach for growth. Build clear career paths, and retain top performers by giving them stretch work, visibility, and a reason to stay.
  • Run the team’s operating rhythm: capacity, account assignments, risk reviews, and pipeline of renewals and expansions.
  • Model the culture: curious, accountable, customer-obsessed, and fun to work with.
  • Personally manage 2 to 5 of the team’s highest-need accounts, including those that are at risk, large, or complex.
  • Ensure your team executes the Qualified Implementation Framework consistently, and bring back what you learn so it keeps improving.
  • Guide strategic customers through architecture, data model, and rollout alongside the Enterprise Architects who run their stack.
  • Prepare and deliver executive-level Quarterly Business Reviews that tie Qualified to customer revenue goals.
  • Own adoption, health, and renewal outcomes for your team’s book. Know every at-risk account before it knows itself.
  • Turn successful customers into advocates through case studies, testimonials, and speaking moments, working hand in hand with Marketing.
  • Give the Director a clear, current view of customer health, renewal risk, and expansion opportunity for your team.
  • Recommend changes to team design, capacity, and investment based on what you see in the book.
  • Build and sustain executive relationships across Salesforce and our customers.
  • Co-plan with Salesforce teams on joint customers, joint pipeline, and joint wins.
  • Engage in internal product discussions, bringing customer feedback into actionable insights to help shape the product roadmap

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of Mid Market/Enterprise software experience
  • 1+ year of people management experience
  • Bachelors Degree required
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong individual contributors.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, persuasion, presentation and writing skills
  • You command a room, from a customer's CMO to a Salesforce executive.
  • Deep working knowledge of Salesforce CRM
  • Deep working knowledge of Qualified
  • Working knowledge of marketing automation systems
  • Knowledge in web / scripting technologies, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and SaaS applications
  • Outstanding problem-solving skills, including the ability to meet a business requirement with a technical solution
  • Must be willing to work in a fast-paced startup environment with multiple roles
  • Passion for making customers successful with software solutions

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
