This isn’t a role for a “form filler” who waits to be reminded, or someone who guesses on sensitive matters instead of asking.

This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll keep HR operations running across the full employee lifecycle, accurately and on time, so senior HR staff can spend their time on decisions, employee relations and recruiting quality.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with the HR team of a mission-driven, US-based sustainability consulting firm who:

  • Champions Innovation: Runs a modern HR stack (Rippling, JazzHR, Trainual) and welcomes AI-assisted drafting, as long as confidential data stays protected.
  • Values Your Growth: Gives you access to an AI-enabled operator community and a dedicated Success Manager (CSM) coaching you through your first 90 days.
  • Respects Your Expertise: Wants you to become the default owner of routine HR admin, with senior HR reviewing your work rather than redoing it, and is open to your improvements to templates, checklists and reminder flows.
  • Provides Clear Guidance: You’ll sit inside an established HR team led by a Director of HR and an HR Manager, so there’s always a clear escalation path.
  • Offers Real Breadth: A genuine HR operations seat covering recruiting, onboarding, training, benefits, leave, performance and offboarding, with hands-on exposure to US HR practice.

You’ll get career transformation, hands-on US HR experience, and the trust to own HR operations end to end, without being stuck in a “data entry only” rut.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core HR operations role covering employee records, onboarding and offboarding, recruiting coordination, and training and programme administration. You aren’t just processing forms; you’re the person who makes sure every request is routed, every record is right, and every checklist is closed, while treating employee data as confidential at every step.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • HR Inbox & Request Routing: Owning day-to-day triage of the HR and recruiting inboxes, routing routine items within one business day and escalating sensitive matters quickly and discreetly to the right person.
  • Employee Records Accuracy: Processing record updates in Rippling within agreed turnaround times, then running a records completeness check and resolving every gap you find.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding Coordination: Running checklists end to end: new-hire and leaver communications, background checks, orientation and exit interview scheduling, and document tracking, with nothing left open past its deadline.
  • Recruiting Coordination: Scheduling interviews, sending candidate communications and tracking assessments in JazzHR for assigned roles, with candidate updates going out within one business day.
  • Training & Programme Administration: Administering harassment prevention training, performance review and survey cycles, and mentorship programmes, and keeping Trainual content current.
  • Benefits, Leave & HR Resources: Handling benefits and leave filing and keeping HR resources up to date for employees.
  • Process Improvement: Improving at least one template, checklist or reminder flow and getting it adopted by the team.

Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Have Real HR Admin Experience: You’ve worked in HR, recruiting or people-ops administration, ideally supporting a US team.
  • Are a Confidential Recordkeeper: You keep employee records accurate and complete, follow access rules without being reminded, and spot missing or inconsistent data before it causes a problem.
  • Close the Loop: You’ve run onboarding, offboarding or recruiting steps end to end, and you track every open item to closure, not just the first step.
  • Know When to Ask: You understand the limits of your authority and escalate sensitive or unfamiliar matters instead of guessing.
  • Write Clearly: Your instructions, reminders and candidate emails are clear enough that people act on them the first time.
  • Are Comfortable in HR Systems: You’ve worked in an HRIS and an applicant tracking system, and you use AI to speed up drafting while protecting confidential data.
  • Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.
  • Communicate with Professional Confidence: You’re comfortable working in writing and on calls with US-based employees, candidates and HR leaders.
  • Can Commit to the Schedule: You can reliably work 20 hours a week within US Pacific business hours.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): Rippling, JazzHR, Trainual, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams or Slack, and Monday.com or ClickUp.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • Nothing Slips Through the Inbox: HR and recruiting requests are routed or actioned within one business day, and sensitive items reach the right person every time.
  • Records Are Clean: Record updates are current with no backlog, and the completeness check is done with every gap resolved.
  • Joiners and Leavers Are Seamless: You run onboarding and offboarding checklists independently, with zero items outstanding past deadline.
  • Programmes Hit Target: A training, performance review or survey cycle is completed to target, and Trainual content is up to date.
  • Trust Is Earned: You’re the default owner of routine HR admin, senior HR reviews rather than redoes your work, and at least one of your process improvements has been adopted.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m organised, discreet and I finish what I start. I just want an HR team that trusts me with the whole employee lifecycle and gives me clear guidance when it matters.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

raw.excerpt: About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs
across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across
teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results.
At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements,
work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns.
You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into

repeatable delivery models.

Responsibilities:

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership
• Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that
span multiple teams and workstreams.
• Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional
requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes.
• Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns.
• Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a
cohesive end-to-end architecture.
• Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and
code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse.
• Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces,
testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable.
• Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help
teams adopt effective practices at program scale.
Delivery and Consulting Excellence
• Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into
integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies.
• Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and
explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.
• Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences,
including executives.
• Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape
modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest.
• Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable
delivery and stable team velocity.
• Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies
are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery.
• Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep
3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones.
• Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable
incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry
and feedback.
• Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to
clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple,

direct language.

Mentorship and Team Development:

  • Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural
    judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.
    • Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making
    and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified.
    • Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and
    mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects.

Growth and Innovation:

  • Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment
    across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them.
    • Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify
    opportunities to provide additional business value.
    • Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision,
    contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.
    • Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting
    assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction.
    • Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter
    repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
    • Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AIassisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
    • Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help
    build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
    • 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams,
    including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
    • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, including 4+ years of experience architecting data
    solutions on Azure.
    • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure with experience with Databricks and/or Fabric.
    • Proven ability to design and implement modern data architectures (data lakes, data warehouses,
    lakehouses, data mesh, streaming pipelines).
    • Proficiency in Python, PySpark, SQL, and data engineering frameworks.
    • Azure DevOps (including building Stories and tasks, and using pipelines and ARM templates for
    publishing code).
    • Knowledge of infrastructure as code, APIs, security, compliance, and master data management.
    • Experience optimizing data pipelines, queries, and architectures for performance and cost.
    • Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as
    modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs.
    • Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and
    solid delivery practices.
    • Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable
    delivery across time zones.
    • Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary
    domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale.
    • Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into
    solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services.
    • Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and
    dependency handling.
    • Experience in consulting or professional services.
    • Familiarity with key Azure services relevant to your domain, such as messaging, compute, data,
    security, networking, and integration.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication.
    • Demonstrated interest in learning new cloud technologies and turning that learning into practical
    improvements for teams.
    • Ability to stay hands-on with architecture and, when needed, implementation while guiding complex

cloud solutions across teams.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 3Cloud we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and
authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly
with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

raw.description:
Overview

We’re hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Strategist to own demand generation for our marketing and leasing solutions. This role is designed for a marketer who blends strategic thinking with strong execution and knows how to turn complex product capabilities into clear, compelling campaigns that drive pipeline and sales momentum. This is a strategic, hands-on role for a marketer who thrives at the intersection of creative storytelling, cross-channel orchestration, and data-driven performance optimization.

As the Senior Growth Marketing Strategist, you will lead the end-to-end strategy and execution of integrated, multi-channel campaigns aligned to product launches, sales priorities, and key buyer personas across the multifamily market. You’ll be responsible for translating product narratives into campaign themes, orchestrating activation across paid and owned channels, and continuously optimizing performance using data and insights.

This role sits at the center of Marketing, Product Marketing, and Sales. Success requires strong cross-functional alignment, clear communication, and the ability to balance creativity with rigor and accountability.

About Realpage: At Realpage, we believe better technology creates stronger communities. For over 25 years, we’ve partnered with multifamily housing operators and property management companies to simplify operations, improve efficiency, and unlock new growth opportunities.

Trusted across the rental housing industry, Realpage delivers property management software, smart AI-driven tools, and industry-leading data and insights that help companies streamline leasing, optimize property and financial performance, and enhance the resident experience.

Our mission is simple: empower property management companies to operate more efficiently, serve residents more effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving rental housing market.

Responsibilities

  • Own integrated campaign strategy and execution for marketing and leasing products, focused on pipeline creation and deal acceleration.
  • Design full-funnel, multi-touch campaigns aligned to personas, verticals, and stages of the buyer journey across paid media, email, web, events, outbound SDR support and content syndication.
  • Partner closely with Product Marketing to translate product positioning and narratives into clear value propositions, campaign themes, and audience-specific messaging.
  • Develop campaign messaging frameworks, content outlines, nurture cadences, and creative briefs tailored to segmented audiences.
  • Collaborate with SEO, web development, paid media, creative, and marketing operations to activate campaigns consistently across all touchpoints.
  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate results and insights to stakeholders.
  • Align with Sales leaders and SDR teams to ensure campaign readiness, clear handoffs, and effective feedback loops that improve conversion.
  • Stay current on evolving demand generation best practices, AI-driven marketing tools, and emerging content formats.
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to Product Marketing and Sales, contributing ideas that improve scale, efficiency, and impact.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years in B2B SaaS demand generation or integrated campaign strategy roles.
  • Demonstrated experience running full-funnel campaigns that combine content strategy, digital media, and outbound motions.
  • Track record of accountability for pipeline performance and campaign optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and marketing automation platforms such as Pardot, Marketo, or HubSpot.
  • Strong command of campaign measurement, attribution, A/B testing, and performance reporting.

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled solutions or previous experience in emerging tech categories
  • Background in multifamily, real estate technology, or adjacent B2B verticals

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

Required Skills & Competencies:

  • Strategic, persona-driven marketer with a strong understanding of integrated campaign design.
  • Clear and confident communicator who can align cross-functional teams’ partners and report results in business terms.
  • Strong writing skills, with the ability to develop campaign themes, nurture flows, and audience-specific narratives.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for innovation, experimentation, and modern marketing approaches, including AI and automation
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, timelines and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Collaborative, pragmatic, and comfortable driving clarity in a fast-paced, matrixed environment

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

This is a remote position, requiring the ability to work effectively in a home-office environment with occasional travel as needed.

Join Our Team:This role offers the opportunity to help bring new marketing, leasing and AI solutions to market and shape how modern marketing supports growth in multifamily housing. You’ll work alongside a smart, collaborative team that values clarity, trust, and performance, and you’ll have meaningful ownership over campaigns that directly impact the business. If you’re excited to lead high-impact campaigns and build what’s next, we’d love to connect.

SALARY AND BENEFITS RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes: • Health, dental, and vision insurance.• Retirement savings plan with company match.• Paid time off and holidays.• Professional development opportunities.• Performance-based bonus based on position. Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

raw.description:
See your work in a new light.

At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux—meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

We’re looking for a Patient Access Liaison (PAL) – Active who wants their work to mean something — someone who brings empathy, precision, and follow‑through to protecting patients’ ongoing access to care.

Compensation:$23.00 to $30.00 per hour, based on experience
Location: Remote
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM CST or EST

Why This Role Matters

The PAL – Active plays a critical role in ensuring patients do not experience interruptions in therapy due to insurance or benefit changes. By proactively monitoring eligibility and authorization status, this role helps remove barriers before they impact patient care.

In this role, your work will:

  • Help patients remain on therapy without delays or disruption
  • Provide clarity and reassurance during insurance or coverage changes
  • Support care teams through accurate documentation and proactive communication

Every follow‑up helps safeguard a patient’s ability to continue treatment with confidence.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor monthly insurance eligibility and authorization status for assigned active patients
  • Review CareTend queues and ensure all authorizations are current and on file before service delivery
  • Identify coverage changes and work directly with patients, sales teams, and physicians to obtain updated insurance or clinical documentation
  • Notify Reimbursement Specialists when new benefits verification or prior authorizations are required
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients, providers, and field partners, answering benefits and authorization questions as they arise
  • Collaborate closely with reimbursement, nurse coordination, pharmacy operations, and data entry teams to keep cases moving forward
  • Communicate potential delays proactively to downstream teams
  • Document all patient, provider, and internal communications accurately in systems of record
  • Track referral status, volume, and workload metrics to organize daily activities and meet service goals
  • Support PAL‑Pending duties as needed to ensure intake coverage and continuity

What We’re Looking For

You may be a great fit if you bring:

  • 1–3 years of experience supporting patient referrals, prescription services, or reimbursement in infusion or specialty therapies
  • Experience delivering high‑quality customer service to patients and healthcare providers
  • Familiarity with electronic health records or pharmacy patient management systems
  • Proficiency in medical or pharmacy terminology
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Moderate proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor’s degree preferred)
  • Willingness to travel up to 5% as needed

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience supporting prescribers, patients, and field teams in infusion or specialty therapy environments
  • General understanding of insurance benefits, payer requirements, and verification processes
  • Familiarity with infusion therapy workflows and patient needs

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe care deserves more light — more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

Here, you’ll find:

  • Purpose‑driven work with direct patient impact
  • A patient‑first, collaborative intake environment
  • Close partnership with clinical, reimbursement, and pharmacy teams
  • Opportunities to grow your expertise while supporting meaningful care journeys

Come help protect patient access to infusion care — and see what’s possible when care comes first.

Pay Range/Rate
$23—$30 USD

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those required for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact the LUX Infusion Talent Team at or 954.385.7322 x 1425.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, or sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee may also be required to occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Employees are expected to:

  • Participate annually in required legal and ethical compliance training
  • Consistently act in compliance with LUX Infusion’s legal, ethical, and compliance policies
  • Adhere to all standards and procedures outlined in the LUX Infusion Compliance Manual
  • Refrain from any behavior that could be considered unethical or unlawful

EXPECTATIONS FOR ALL EMPLOYEES

All LUX Infusion team members are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision, and values by demonstrating integrity, dedication, compassion, and enthusiasm. This includes placing patients first, working collaboratively with a “stacked‑hands” mindset, and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

GENERAL INFORMATION

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals in this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

This role operates in a fast‑paced environment and requires the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage multiple tasks effectively, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Employees in this position may be required to assist directly - or coordinate appropriate assistance - to ensure access to LUX Infusion’s services for individuals with disabilities, including patients, visitors, employees, or others.

LUX Infusion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

CRM Technical Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: CRM Technical Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce Technical Architect to design and govern enterprise Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Industry Clouds. The role drives the technical strategy of complex, multi-org Salesforce environments, sets standards for security, integration, and customization, and partners with business stakeholders and engineering teams to deliver scalable, maintainable solutions. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce at enterprise scale, holds strong opinions on declarative versus programmatic trade-offs, and brings deep platform mastery combined with practical architectural judgment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define Salesforce technical architecture across Sales, Service, Experience, Marketing, and Industry Cloud implementations.
  • Lead solution design, technical review boards, and governance for major Salesforce initiatives.
  • Establish standards for declarative versus programmatic implementation, including Flow, Apex, LWC, and integration patterns.
  • Architect data models, sharing models, and large-data-volume strategies across complex orgs.
  • Design integration architectures using MuleSoft, Salesforce Connect, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Composite APIs.
  • Lead org strategy decisions including single-org vs. multi-org, sandbox strategy, and DevOps pipelines.
  • Define security architecture including profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and OAuth/SSO patterns.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management across complex Apex and LWC implementations.
  • Establish DevOps and release management practices using Salesforce DX, Copado, Gearset, or AutoRABIT.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate complex CRM requirements into pragmatic Salesforce solutions.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Coordinate with security, compliance, and audit teams to ensure proper controls.
  • Stay current with Salesforce roadmap, Einstein/AI features, and platform innovations.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time in architecture or technical leadership roles.
  • Deep expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, sharing model, and platform limits.
  • Hands-on experience with complex Salesforce integrations.
  • Experience designing security models at enterprise scale.
  • Experience with Salesforce DX and modern DevOps tooling.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect credentials.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce programs end-to-end.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) credential.
  • Experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds such as Financial Services Cloud or Health Cloud.
  • Exposure to Einstein AI / Agentforce features.
  • Experience with multi-org consolidation or M&A integrations.

Overview

Claims Process Coordinator

Reports to: Compliance Manager

Fully Remote, Exempt position

Salary Range: $70,000 to $85,000 depending on experience

Position Summary

Sun Auto Tire & Service is one of the nation's fastest-growing automotive service companies, operating more than 575 locations across the United States through a family of trusted local brands. Powered by the Sun Auto Network, we combine the personalized service of neighborhood repair shops with the resources, technology, and innovation of a national organization to deliver exceptional tire and automotive care.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Compliance Support Specialist to support insurance administration and claims management. This role is focused on reviewing and facilitating insurance claims, coordinating with store managers, district managers, market directors, vendors, and the Safety team, and managing claims from intake through resolution. The position also supports insurance documentation needs, including certificates of insurance, incident tracking and reporting, EHS Insight data entry and review, and day-to-day management of the claims and insurance email inbox. This role is focused on insurance administration and claims management. Vehicle title/registration management, DOT compliance, approved driver maintenance, vehicle disposition, toll accounts, licenses, permits, and other vehicle management responsibilities have been removed from this job description.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Claims Management

  • Review incoming claims and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and follow-up needs.
  • Coordinate with store managers, district managers, market directors, and other internal partners to gather missing information and resolve claim-related questions.
  • Manage claims from intake through resolution, including follow-up on open items, vendor responses, status updates, and documentation needs.
  • Communicate with insurance carriers, adjusters, third-party administrators, repair vendors, towing/storage vendors, and other outside partners as needed to support claim handling.
  • Track claim status, outstanding action items, costs, and resolution notes to maintain clear and accurate claim records.
  • Escalate complex, high-cost, litigated, or sensitive claims to the appropriate internal stakeholders.

Incident Reporting & EHS Insight Support

  • Work in EHS Insight to review, update, and maintain incident and claim-related information.
  • Partner closely with the Safety team to ensure incidents are documented consistently and routed appropriately.
  • Assist with reporting on incident volume, claim trends, cost types, claim status, and other insurance or incident-related metrics.
  • Identify gaps in incident documentation and follow up with field leadership or internal teams to obtain required details.

Insurance Administration

About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

The main purpose of the Amazon Operations Manager is to support the management and day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts for Hustler Marketing's clients. This includes managing inventory, coordinating shipments, setting up promotions, supporting product launches, uploading content, preparing reports, and resolving operational challenges to help clients improve their performance and grow their businesses on Amazon.

As an Amazon Operations Manager, you will work across multiple client brands and Amazon marketplaces, primarily in the UK, EU, and US, as well as Canada, Mexico, Australia, and Japan. Your responsibilities will involve analyzing sales and inventory data, identifying operational issues and growth opportunities, making recommendations based on your findings, and executing tasks that support each client's goals. You will need to understand how different aspects of Amazon operations affect a brand's performance, from inventory availability and product listings to promotions and new product launches.

A significant part of this role involves problem-solving. Amazon is a constantly evolving platform, and you will regularly encounter situations that require you to investigate unfamiliar issues, evaluate available information, and find practical solutions. You will work closely with the team, receive training on the agency's processes and ways of working, and participate in regular training and feedback sessions to continuously develop your expertise.


About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Amazon Operations Manager is to ensure that the operational activities of our clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts are managed accurately and effectively, while supporting their business growth through data-driven decisions, consistent execution, and proactive problem-solving.

As our Amazon Operations Manager, this will include monitoring and managing inventory, identifying replenishment priorities, supporting product launches and promotional activities, analyzing sales and operational performance, and providing recommendations that help clients make informed decisions. You will be expected to approach challenges logically, take initiative in finding solutions, improve existing processes, and maintain a high standard of accuracy across your work.


General Responsibilities:

  • Managing and supporting the day-to-day operations of assigned clients' Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts across different marketplaces
  • Setting up, monitoring, and managing inventory to support product availability and meet client requirements
  • Analyzing inventory levels, historical sales, and product performance to identify products that require replenishment or are at risk of running out of stock
  • Identifying products with excess inventory and recommending appropriate actions based on sales performance and available stock
  • Setting up and coordinating shipments to Amazon warehouses, ensuring that inventory-related activities are executed accurately
  • Supporting new product launches by completing the necessary operational setup
  • Uploading and updating product content within Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central
  • Monitoring product and listing performance, investigating potential issues, and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Interacting with Amazon Support to investigate operational issues, resolve problems, and follow up on outstanding matters
  • Creating and maintaining reports that provide insights into sales performance, inventory levels, and other relevant business metrics
  • Analyzing product performance across different product lines, variations, and categories to identify potential growth opportunities
  • Supporting strategic decisions by identifying which products or product lines should be prioritized based on sales performance, available inventory, and other relevant data
  • Identifying products or activities that may need to be deprioritized and explaining the reasoning behind those recommendations
  • Recognizing limitations in available data and identifying additional information needed to make more accurate operational and business decisions
  • Preparing clear, structured explanations of findings, recommendations, and proposed next steps for clients and internal team members
  • Identifying operational problems, investigating their causes, and developing practical solutions to resolve them
  • Taking initiative to research and resolve unfamiliar Amazon-related challenges, with support from the wider team when required
  • Ensuring that assigned operational tasks and recommended actions are implemented effectively and in line with client objectives
  • Participating in regular training, feedback, and professional development sessions to strengthen Amazon platform knowledge and operational capabilities
  • Continuously developing knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central, and related tools to improve the quality and effectiveness of work
  • Contributing to the overall success of assigned clients by improving operational execution, identifying opportunities, and supporting business growth


Position Specs:

  • Fully remote position
  • Ready to start as soon as possible
  • Start on a probationary period at an hourly rate.
  • Opportunity to transition into a full-time position within the Amazon Operations team with a fixed-rate monthly salary following a successful probation period
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the probationary period
  • Regular training, feedback sessions, and professional development opportunities

Requirements

About You:

Profile:

The ideal candidate should have practical experience working with Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central and a strong interest in Amazon, e-commerce, and digital marketing. You should be comfortable navigating Amazon's operational environment, working with product and inventory information, and using data to make logical decisions that support business performance. You should have a solid analytical mindset and enjoy working with spreadsheets, reports, and numerical data. You should be able to look beyond individual products to understand broader patterns across product lines, categories, and variations.

The Amazon Operations Manager should be a curious and resourceful problem-solver who can approach unfamiliar situations with confidence and determination. You will need to investigate issues, identify potential causes, research possible solutions, and take the necessary actions to resolve them.   • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to analyze, organize, and interpret numerical data effectively

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to independently investigate challenges, evaluate possible solutions, and take practical action
  • Experience communicating with Amazon Support or handling operational issues within Seller Central or Vendor Central
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when working with product information, inventory figures, and operational tasks
  • Ability to create clear reports and communicate findings, recommendations, and next steps in a logical and understandable manner
  • Ability to take initiative, execute ideas effectively, and follow through on assigned responsibilities
  • Ability to work across different Amazon marketplaces and support the operational needs of multiple client brands

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.excerpt: About Board of InnovationBOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact.
raw.description:
About Board of Innovation

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.

About the Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to design and build the AI systems behind real, production-grade applications. This is applied engineering work: building agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and orchestration layers that integrate into business-critical environments and stand up to real-world use.

You'll take AI capabilities from idea to deployment, owning the full path including evaluation, observability, and the operational concerns that determine whether a system survives contact with users.

What You'll Do

You'll design, implement, and ship AI systems that automate work, support decisions, and unlock new workflows for enterprise clients. Day-to-day, that means building multi-step agents and tool-using LLM systems, wiring them into structured and unstructured data sources, and packaging them into services that other engineers and applications can consume safely.

You'll also own how we know our systems work. That includes evals, observability, and the feedback loops that let us iterate with confidence rather than guesswork. You'll work closely with engineers, strategists, and designers, and you'll be in client conversations from early scoping through delivery.

What You Bring

You have 3+ years of experience shipping AI-powered systems in production, and a background in computer science, math, physics, engineering, or another technical or scientific field. You're strong in Python and fluent in the patterns of modern LLM engineering: agents, MCP, skills, tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, and evals.

You're also a real software engineer underneath. CI/CD, testing, version control hygiene, and code quality matter to you, because they're what let you keep moving fast without things falling over. You understand how to balance accuracy, latency, cost, and maintainability, and you've debugged enough production systems to have opinions about it. You're comfortable wrapping AI logic into services that other engineers can consume without surprises.

How You Work

You treat AI as an engineering discipline. You care about observability, maintainability, and the underlying engineering that makes the interesting parts possible. You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain and a new set of constraints.

At BOI, you will work a lot with strategists, designers, and consultants, and most of your clients aren't technical. You're comfortable translating between business problems and technical solutions, and you can hold your own in a client room without a project manager running interference for you.

The field moves quickly, and so do we. New models, new tools, and new patterns show up constantly. You enjoy that pace, actively pull in what's useful, and bring it back to the team. You push back when something doesn't make sense, and you care about building systems that get used long after the kickoff energy fades.

Contract & Setup

We are open to both permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements. The final setup will depend on your location, work authorization status, and local compliance requirements.

Interested?

If this sounds like a fit, apply with your CV and a short note on a system you've built that you're proud of. Bonus points for something we can actually look at!

title: Demand Generation Lead
description: About RefoldEnterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants.

raw.title: Demand Generation Lead
raw.excerpt: About RefoldEnterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants.
raw.description:
About Refold

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. Demand gen has changed. In the AI era, the person who owns the pipeline number also builds the system that produces it: signals, scoring, and AI agents decide which accounts we talk to, when, and why, and the demand gen lead writes that software. That is how this seat works at Refold. You'll inherit an engine that already runs in production, and your job is to make it produce more.


Key Responsibilities

Own the number

  • Carry the target: Discovery calls, demos, and sourced pipeline are yours across every motion: outbound, events, inbound, and ABM. You set the quarterly plan, forecast against it, and answer for the gap

  • Lead the BDR team: Five BDRs report to you. You hire, coach, and set their targets, and you decide who they contact, in what order, and with what message across calls, email, and LinkedIn

  • Run outreach end to end: The weekly action list each rep works from is your product, and so is its hit rate. When meetings drop, you find out whether the problem is the list, the message, or the execution, and you fix it

  • Own the number in motions you don't run: Events, inbound, and ABM are executed by other teams. You set the pipeline target for each with them, supply the target lists and follow-up, and hold the combined number

  • Fix the leaks: Track conversion from first conversation through demo and proof of concept, find where good accounts stall, and fix the handoff with the AEs

  • Report the truth: Publish the weekly demand gen update the whole GTM team runs on. Snapshot and cohort views, built from CRM stage history, that change decisions

  • Manage the budget: Programme spend and per-vendor credit budgets. Every tool earns its place by the job it does, and you retire the ones that stop earning it

Build the engine

  • Maintain the GTM system: A production codebase runs our signals, account scoring, and AI sales agents. You are its maintainer: you write the code, ship it, deploy it, and get paged when it breaks. Nobody else builds it for you

  • Ship every day: Small, working changes go to production daily. The people using what you build sit next to you and will tell you the same afternoon whether it works

  • Build and tune the agents: Account research, battle cards, drafted outreach, demo briefs, and handoff notes are generated by AI agents the team uses daily. You write the prompts and tools, run the evals, and gate anything before it reaches a rep or a prospect

  • Run the data platform: A warehouse of several thousand target accounts is the source of truth, with the CRM on top. Keep ingest healthy, roll-ups fresh, and the two in sync

  • Build the signal layer: Website visitors, intent data, job changes, hiring, funding, LinkedIn engagement, and event attendance. Decide which signals matter, wire them in, and prove they predict meetings

  • Keep the ICP executable: Our tiering and scoring rubric is code, and every classification must trace back to it. Tune it against closed-won and closed-lost deals each quarter

  • Stay at the frontier: B2B outreach and inbound are changing every quarter. Know what the best teams are doing now, test it here within weeks, and keep only what moves the number

  • Make it reliable: Scheduled jobs, alerts, data-quality audits, and deploys that verify themselves. If a rep opens an empty list on Monday morning, that's yours

Role Information

  • Reports to: Head of Marketing

  • Manages: A team of 5 BDRs and all demand gen numbers

  • Works closest with: The AEs, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, GTM Operations, and the founders

  • Audience: CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, and VPs of Professional Services / Delivery at sales-led software companies

  • Stack: HubSpot, a Postgres warehouse, Python services on cloud infrastructure, enrichment and intent vendors, and coding agents for the AI layer

  • Time split: 50% running the number, 50% building

  • Location: San Francisco Bay Area, in office

Your First 90 Days

  1. By day 30: You publish the weekly demand gen update and the BDR action lists yourself, and you've shipped your first fix to production

  2. By day 60: You deploy and operate the GTM system without help, and you've changed at least one thing about targeting that shows up in the meeting rate

  3. By day 90: The next quarter's demand gen plan and number are yours, written by you and signed off by the founders

Required Skills & Abilities

  • You've carried a pipeline number: 5–10 years in demand gen or growth at B2B SaaS, with at least one stretch where the meetings and pipeline target was yours alone

  • You've built AI agents a team uses: Not a demo or a side project. Agents that sellers or marketers rely on in their daily work, and you can show them to us

  • You ship code every day: Claude Code, coding+deployment and SQL in production, deployed by you. You're as comfortable in a terminal as in a CRM, and a coding agent is already part of how you work

  • You've shipped something other people use: A tool, product, or internal system with real users, that works, and that you kept working after launch

  • You know the state of the art: You can explain what has changed in B2B outreach and inbound in the last twelve months, what you've tested yourself, and what you'd stop doing

  • You've led outbound: You've managed or closely directed BDRs, and you can tell from the call data what's going wrong

  • Account-based instinct: You've sold into a small, named market with long cycles and several stakeholders per deal, where list quality matters more than volume

  • Funnel-literate and a clear writer: You reason in cohorts and conversion rates, and a founder, a BDR, and an engineer can each read your update once and know what to do

  • High ownership: No ops team, no data team, no agency. You'll debug the pipeline at night and present the forecast in the morning, and that's the appeal

  • Presence matters: Based in the SF Bay Area and working from our office

Nice to Have

  • Sold to technical or enterprise-software buyers, or worked in the ERP and integration ecosystem (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce)

  • Been the first growth or GTM hire at a seed or Series A company

  • Founded a company or built a product from zero

  • Deep CRM API experience: custom properties, stage history, association models

  • Run events, ABM advertising, or inbound programmes yourself

Why do you want to work here?

  • Impact: Fast-growing seed-stage company ($6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes

  • Speed: You inherit a GTM system that already runs in production, so your first quarter goes into improving it instead of building the basics

  • Ownership: The number, the team, and the machine are all yours. This is demand gen done the way the best teams will run it in two years, and you get to do it now

Compensation:

  • $180,000 - $210,000 (Annually)

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're a small, fast-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here.

Compensation Range: $180K - $210K
