raw.excerpt: Get to know us betterCodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
raw.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

This project focuses on designing, qualifying, hardening, and shipping production-grade SONiC platform releases across diverse white-box hardware platforms and ASIC architectures. The technical mandate extends from low-level Linux kernel and platform driver bring-up to deep SWSS feature development, Redis state database tuning, and SAI/SDK bug isolation.

You will lead a team of systems developers, network engineers, and test automation specialists operating across extensive multi-vendor testbeds. The team takes end-to-end technical ownership of platform stability, driving complex NOS, SAI, and SDK defect resolutions directly with tier-1 silicon vendors.

What else you should know:

  • The team acts as a key technical authority, collaborating directly with client architects and silicon vendor engineering groups.

  • Delivery follows Agile engineering methodologies taking direct ownership of software architecture, system performance, and code quality.

  • Because our partners and clients operate globally across US Silicon Valley and European time zones, flexibility for occasional afternoon coordination calls is expected.

Your role

As a SONiC Technical Lead, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading the end-to-end qualification, bring-up, and shipping of robust SONiC releases across physical switch targets in complex data center topologies

  • Designing, extending, and debugging core SONiC subsystems, including SWSS, syncd, Redis in-memory state databases, and Linux system services.

  • Systematically isolating failures across all layers, and driving resolution with silicon vendors.

  • Debugging transaction processing and pub/sub notification mechanisms between APPL_DB, ASIC_DB, and syncd to prevent state desynchronization and ensure wire-speed route programming.

  • Architecting automated regression workflows (Pytest, PTF, sonic-mgmt, Ansible) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to validate forwarding, congestion, and L2/L3 resiliency.

  • Utilizing packet captures, kernel debug tools (gdb, perf, BPF), diagnostic logs, Redis telemetry, and line-rate traffic generators (TRex, PTF, Keysight) to perform root-cause analysis on system-level anomalies.

  • Leveraging advanced AI engineering utilities (AI-assisted log analysis, LLM coding assistants, automated RCA scripts) to accelerate defect isolation and test automation cycles.

  • Conducting rigorous code reviews across C/C++, Python, and Go codebases, mentoring team members, and maintaining high standards for code quality and maintainability.

Do we have a match?

As a SONiC Technical Lead, you must meet the following core criteria:

  • Proven track record of shipping, qualifying, and hardening production-grade SONiC platforms on physical switch hardware.

  • Expert-level hands-on experience with SWSS, syncd, Redis state databases, and SAI.

  • Demonstrated ability to isolate complex bugs across NOS application software, SAI wrapper logic, and vendor-proprietary silicon SDKs, driving fixes through vendor engineering channels.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in C/C++ and Python within Linux environments, including multi-threading, IPC mechanisms, socket programming, and system calls.

  • Understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking standards (BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, VLAN, QoS, RoCEv2, PFC, ECN).

  • Strong experience with Linux networking internals, kernel drivers, sysfs, dmesg, gdb, perf, tcpdump, and systemd service management.

  • Hands-on experience with Python-based test frameworks, including PTF and pytest.

  • Deep familiarity and working knowledge of the sonic-mgmt repository structure and test suite implementation.

  • Proficiency with containerization tools and workflows, specifically Docker.

  • Practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and orchestration.

  • Hands-on experience building and integrating automated CI/CD pipelines.

  • Good knowledge of English (B2+ level minimum) for clear technical communication, documentation, and vendor technical discussions.

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Hands-on software development experience with Golang.

  • Direct experience working with hardware acceleration, DPDK, eBPF, or SmartNIC/DPU offloading architectures.

  • Hands-on familiarity with proprietary silicon SDKs (e.g., Broadcom SDK/SAI, NVIDIA Spectrum SDK, Intel Barefoot SDE).

  • Experience with commercial network operating systems (Cisco IOS-XE/XR, JunOS, Arista EOS).

  • Practical experience integrating GenAI or LLM-assisted workflows for automated log parsing and system diagnostics.

  • Formal professional certifications in networking (CCNA/CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE) or software engineering is a plus.

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office (Warsaw), or hybrid.

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions (Tech Talks) and a training budget.

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start.

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who specialize in low-level engineering, networking, and cloud automation.

  • The ability to change the project you are working on within CodiLime's multi-client portfolio.

Kyra sits where creators and brands meet. One side of the business runs influencer campaigns end to end. The other builds our subscription product, the platform behind them. Both are growing fast, which is where you come in.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

You'll be the "eyes and ears" of GTM—making sure everyone knows what is being built, when, and why it matters–and the “megaphone” for the PM team, making sure that we maximize product investments for the business.

Product Expertise & Collaboration

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work closely with Product and Product Design teams on UX iterations, bringing the customer and market perspective

  • Maintain a Voice of Customer program to inform product and messaging strategy

  • Help translate competitive intelligence and market insights back to Product teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Launch Excellence: Predictable, scalable feature launches that consistently generate excitement among internal teams and customers while driving clear market differentiation

  • Product Adoption: New features achieve strong adoption rates, demonstrating clear value delivery

  • Customer Impact: Contributions to improved renewal rates and expansion opportunities through better product understanding and positioning

  • Team Enablement: GTM teams are confident, well-informed product advocates who can articulate value clearly

Who You Are

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5-7 years of Product Marketing experience in B2B SaaS or related go-to-market roles

  • Technical Collaboration: Proven experience working directly with technical teams, especially those building AI agents or complex technical products

  • Launch Track Record: Prior experience running cross-functional product launches from planning through execution

  • Exceptional Communication: Strong storytelling and writing skills with the ability to craft product marketing copy that drives differentiation, establishes voice, and clearly articulates value

  • Product Intuition: Natural ability to identify what drives value and to design a strategy and story that non-technical teams can understand and sell

  • Deep Product Partnership: Ability to become "mind-melded" with Product Managers, understanding their goals, priorities, risks, and what makes them tick

raw.title: Operations Associate (Hiring or Client Delivery)
raw.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
raw.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in South Africa.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

On top of that:

A one-month annual bonus.

15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country’s public holidays.
Paid sick leave.
A health allowance.

A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Indonesia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Indonesia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About the Company & Mission

We are an early-stage (Seed), venture-backed cross-border neobank and retail brokerage built for global investors. Our mission is to bridge financial borders across the Pacific: building a single platform where US investors can directly access, trade, and hold high-growth Asian equities (such as Korean and Japanese markets) as seamlessly as trading domestic US stocks.

By combining an AI-native back end, real-time translated market research/filings, automated FX, multi-currency custody, and compliant clearing/settlement rails, we are removing the friction from international investing. Starting with a focus on cross-border retail brokerage, our long-term vision spans multi-currency banking, stablecoin-enabled instant cross-border settlement, and direct global market access on a single shelf.

We run on absolute trust: moving real capital across international borders requires rock-solid, auditable, and resilient infrastructure. We are actively expanding our founding engineering team to build out core systems on our path toward full brokerage self-clearing operations.

Why This Role Exists

As a modern retail brokerage, our backend is the core product. You will carry three of the company’s most critical technical deliverables:

  1. Build the financial foundation: Own the services driving order lifecycles, internal ledgers, multi-currency funding flows, and automated reconciliation from day one.

  2. Scale with precision: Build high-throughput, fault-tolerant infrastructure capable of expanding from early users to hundreds of thousands of active investors without compromising auditability or data integrity.

  3. Set engineering standards: Partner directly with the CTO to define company-wide standards for correctness, distributed system reliability, and production operational excellence.

This is a founding-stage seat offering deep technical ownership and high agency over architecture, product decisions, and system design.

What You Will Own

    • Core Financial Engine: Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end order routing, execution lifecycles, internal double-entry ledgers, and automated funding/reconciliation systems.

    • Resilient Architecture: Build production systems optimized for concurrency and partial network failures using idempotent handlers, durable event history, replayable state, and self-healing mechanisms.

    • Third-Party & Banking Integrations: Integrate directly with partner clearing broker-dealers, international brokers, banking rails (ACH, wires), FX mechanisms, and automated KYC/AML verification providers.

    • Production Excellence: Take end-to-end operational ownership—including sandbox testing environments, monitoring/alerting, incident response, on-call rotations, and postmortems.

    • Internal Operational Tooling: Build robust internal tools and dashboards for operations, compliance, and support teams to audit, investigate, and resolve issues proactively.

    • Data & AI Infrastructure Support: Support underlying data pipelines powering our real-time AI research and content-translation engines (no dedicated ML background required).

Who We Are Looking For

    Must-Have:

    • Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience building, scaling, and maintaining high-availability production backend systems.

    • Financial Data Rigor: Proven track record of owning mission-critical systems handling sensitive transactions (e.g., money movement, balances, orders, ledgering, or high-integrity financial data).

    • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in a modern backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js, Rust, or Java) and production data infrastructure (relational DBs, distributed event queues/streams, caching layers).

    • System Design & Correctness: Strong instincts for distributed systems trade-offs—data modeling, transaction isolation, idempotency, failure domain isolation, and state reconciliation.

    • Production Maturity: Hands-on experience with on-call rotations, incident management, performance tuning, and writing thorough postmortems.

    • Startup Mindset: High comfort navigating ambiguity, making pragmatic engineering trade-offs, and contributing to both product strategy and technical architecture.

      • Strong Nice-to-Have:

      • Experience scaling consumer fintech, crypto, or brokerage platforms to 100k+ active users.

      • Domain knowledge in capital markets (Order Management Systems/OMS, market data, tax-lot accounting, corporate actions, post-trade settlement).

      • Experience integrating with partner broker-dealers, clearing platforms, or Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) APIs.

      • Hands-on experience with double-entry accounting ledgers, multi-currency FX rails, or stablecoin/on-chain settlement.

      • Cross-border regulatory awareness or language fluency relevant to East Asian markets (e.g., Korean or Japanese).

      • Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tools and workflows that accelerate shipping velocity without compromising correctness.

Who Is NOT the Right Fit

  • Engineers who prefer taking pre-written tickets rather than driving problem definition, system design, and execution from zero.

  • Engineers who view data correctness, logging, observability, and auditability as secondary considerations.

  • Engineers seeking a purely advisory role without willingness to carry operational and production on-call responsibilities.

This is a fully remote position in Taiwan.

raw.description:
About Phorest

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, Phorest builds software and AI-powered tools used by more than 155,000 hair, beauty, and medspa professionals worldwide. We're a product-led SaaS company solving real-world problems across bookings, payments, marketing, and business management, with a big focus on building great experiences for both the businesses we serve and the people who use our products. Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

We're building something exciting at Phorest.

We've established a strong reputation in the hair and beauty industry, and now we're investing in our next big growth opportunity: the North American medspa market.

We're looking for a curious, driven, and entrepreneurial Sales Development Representative (SDR) – MedSpa to help us introduce Phorest to medspa businesses across North America and create meaningful opportunities for growth.

This isn't your typical SDR role. You'll be joining us as we build our presence in a new market, helping us identify the right customers, start conversations, and create opportunities for our Sales team. You'll play an important role in shaping how we approach medspa prospects, testing what works, and building the foundations for future growth.

You'll focus on engaging established, multi-provider medspas, understanding their challenges, and demonstrating how Phorest can help them run and grow their businesses. From researching potential customers and developing personalized outreach to qualifying opportunities and booking meetings for our Account Executives, you'll have a direct impact on our success in this market.

And this won't all happen behind a screen. You'll also get out into the medspa community, attending industry conferences, trade shows, and partner events, meeting prospective customers, and helping build Phorest's presence in the market firsthand.

We're looking for someone with a genuine self-starter mentality. Someone who's comfortable picking up the phone, asking great questions, learning new technology, and figuring things out along the way. You won't always have a fully established playbook to follow, so you'll need to be resourceful, resilient, and willing to experiment.

If you're excited by the opportunity to get involved early, take real ownership, and help build something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Find and engage the right medspa businesses

  • Research and identify established, multi-provider medspas that align with Phorest's ideal customer profile.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of potential customers through proactive outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.

  • Start meaningful conversations with medspa owners, operators, and practice leaders, understanding their needs and introducing the value of Phorest.

  • Qualify potential opportunities and schedule high-quality meetings for our Account Executives.

  • Work closely with the Sales team to ensure a smooth transition from initial outreach to sales conversations.

Create opportunities through targeted outreach

  • Develop and execute personalized outreach strategies for priority medspa accounts and regions.

  • Partner with Marketing to support targeted campaigns, Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives, gifting programs, and events.

  • Follow up with prospects from medspa conferences, webinars, and partner activities, turning initial interest into qualified sales opportunities.

  • Test different approaches, messaging, and outreach channels to understand what resonates with medspa buyers and improve conversion rates.

  • Use tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to organize prospecting activity, manage leads, and track progress.

Get out into the medspa community

  • Represent Phorest at medspa conferences, trade shows, partner events, and other industry gatherings across North America.

  • Connect with medspa owners, operators, and industry partners in person, building relationships and identifying new sales opportunities.

  • Work closely with Marketing and Sales to support event preparation, on-site engagement, lead generation, and post-event follow-up.

  • Use insights and conversations from industry events to strengthen prospecting strategies and help shape how we approach the medspa market.

Collaborate, learn, and help shape our approach

  • Work closely with our MedSpa Marketing and Sales teams to share insights on lead quality, customer feedback, and campaign performance.

  • Collaborate with our Partnerships team to engage partner-sourced leads and identify opportunities for warm introductions.

  • Stay curious about the medspa industry, including market trends, competitors, business models, and the challenges facing medspa owners.

  • Build strong product knowledge so you can confidently communicate how Phorest helps medspa businesses succeed.

  • Share what you're learning from conversations with prospects, helping us refine our messaging and improve how we approach the market.

Take ownership of your results

  • Own your prospecting activity and work toward monthly and quarterly meeting and opportunity creation targets.

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, customer interactions, and pipeline activity within our CRM.

  • Monitor key performance metrics, including outreach activity, response rates, meetings booked, and qualified opportunities generated.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve your approach, build stronger relationships, and contribute to pipeline growth.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who's motivated by the opportunity to build, learn, and make a real impact.

You don't need years of traditional sales experience or to have worked in the medspa industry before. What's more important is your attitude, curiosity, and ability to create momentum.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience in sales development, prospecting, lead generation, or another customer-facing role where you've demonstrated strong communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Confidence engaging potential customers through phone, email, and social channels, with the ability to start conversations and build rapport.

  • A natural curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new products, technologies, and industries.

  • A proactive, self-starter mentality, with the confidence to take initiative and work independently without needing a fully established playbook.

  • Resilience and persistence. You're comfortable hearing "no," learning from setbacks, and adapting your approach.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, priorities, and follow-up activities.

  • A willingness to experiment with new outreach strategies, test messaging, and use feedback and data to improve results.

  • Familiarity with CRM or sales engagement tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar platforms.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally and confidently with business owners and decision-makers.

  • A collaborative mindset, with the ability to work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships teams toward shared goals.

  • Willingness and ability to travel across North America to attend industry conferences, trade shows, partner events, and customer engagements.

Even better if you have:

  • Experience in SaaS, B2B technology sales, or a startup or high-growth business environment.

  • Knowledge of the medspa, medical aesthetics, skincare, beauty, or wellness industries.

  • Experience engaging small and medium-sized business owners or multi-location operators.

  • Familiarity with Account-Based Marketing (ABM), personalized outbound campaigns, or event-driven lead generation.

  • Experience using AI-powered sales tools or automation to improve prospect research, personalize outreach, and streamline workflows.

Benefits

🧘 Phorest currently offers a range of fully employer-paid benefits including Medical, Dental, Life, AD&D, Short Term Disability, an EAP, and wellness perks.

💰 Employees also have access to optional extras, such as a 401(k) and a range of upgraded insurance options.

🤓 Career development is important to us. We even have our own in-house Learning and Development/Business coach and many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

😎 We like to have fun, build camaraderie through regular social events.

👯 Phorest also encourages Employee Resource Groups, you will have the opportunity to join or champion a club, society, or group.

Phorest is an equal opportunities employer. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Overview

Reward & Recognition Manager

Help shape the reward, benefits and recognition framework for a newly integrated global organisation, and lead its implementation

Location: Flexible, with a preference for the successful candidate to be based at one of our MAF International entities.

MAF International is a Christian not-for-profit organisation that uses aviation to deliver essential services — medical evacuations, supplies, disaster relief and education — to remote communities across Africa and Asia Pacific.

With an 80-year history, MAF International is undergoing a major transformation — integrating a historically federated structure into a single global organisation, with the goal of reaching more than 5,000 remote communities by 2045. Its new People Operations and Strategic Projects function is being built now, and this role helps shape it from the start.

Why this role matters

Designing reward across many countries and currencies — competitive enough to attract talent, equitable enough that colleagues trust the system, and financially sustainable — is a genuinely complex problem. You would shape the answer alongside colleagues around the world.

As Reward and Recognition Manager you lead a department of two sub-functions — pay structures and framework, and benefits, allowances and recognition — serving around 850 staff across roughly 20 pay and legal jurisdictions, including some 120 internationally mobile staff. This is a build role, not a caretaker role: you’ll bring reward expertise to our global reward framework project, alongside an external specialist partner and colleagues across the organisation, and then own its implementation, monitoring and governance.

Please note: Candidates must hold existing legal working rights for their proposed location of employment.

Salary: Competitive and flexible, with remuneration aligned to the successful candidate’s location, experience, and local employment context.

Responsibilities

💡 What You'll Be Doing

  • Embed the approved reward and recognition framework across our geographies — balancing market competitiveness, internal equity and affordability.
  • Act as reward specialist in the global reward framework project, then own the approved framework’s implementation, monitoring and governance across MAF International.
  • Develop and maintain the methodology behind international pay: north/south pay frameworks, cost-of-living methodology and hardship scales.
  • Set global minimum standards for benefits while keeping their design and delivery close to each local employment market.
  • Design recognition approaches with L&OD and People Care that reinforce agreed behaviours and contribution.
  • Contribute to a People and Culture and Finance project on how payroll will be organised across the countries we operate in.
  • Advise leadership up to Board level on reward philosophy and lead a small expert team.

Click here for the full job description

Closing date: Applications close on the 27th November

We reserve the right to close this vacancy before the advertised closing date if we receive a sufficient number of applications. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

🌏 What You'll Bring

  • A successful track record in a senior global reward role, ideally in an international or not-for-profit organisation.
  • Experience designing international pay frameworks — north/south structures, COLA methodology and expatriate compensation.
  • Deep technical craft: job evaluation, market benchmarking, pay structures and recognition practice.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills; a compensation certification is welcome.
  • The ability to make reward clear and credible — so people at every level understand and trust how they’re paid.
  • High integrity, courageous judgement, and the ability to make reward decisions that hold organisational, financial and values considerations together.
  • You share our vision, mission and values.

Why MAF?

  • A rare chance to build, not just run — you join as the function takes shape, with genuine influence on its design.
  • Work from anywhere: this role is globally remote, because talent matters more than time zone.
  • A small, expert team with real influence, in an organisation whose work has measurable impact.

Join us

If you are an experienced reward professional who wants to use your expertise for something bigger than remuneration alone, we would love to hear from you. Please click on the 'Enquire Now' link and register your interest.

raw.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

You will own how this system behaves on desktop environments. Your work focuses on reliability, performance, and real-time behavior in production desktop applications.

Focus

  • Build and maintain cross-platform desktop applications using Electron.

  • Design responsive and scalable UIs for real-time collaboration.

  • Implement desktop-specific functionality including file system access, native notifications, auto-updates, and deep linking.

  • Integrate AI-powered features (chat, agents, AI assistance) via backend APIs.

  • Optimize startup time, memory usage, and runtime performance.

  • Profile and reduce Electron overhead.

  • Manage large local state and message history efficiently.

  • Ensure smooth real-time updates (messages, typing indicators, presence).

  • Maintain stability across macOS and Windows environments.

Ideal Experiences

  • Proven software engineering experience.

  • Hands-on experience building production Electron applications.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.

  • Experience with React or similar UI frameworks.

  • Solid understanding of the desktop application lifecycle.

  • Experience with IPC communication.

  • Experience working with local storage (SQLite, IndexedDB, filesystem).

  • Experience with WebSockets or other real-time transport mechanisms.

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

  • Familiarity with native OS behaviors on macOS or Windows.

Tech Stack

  • Electron

  • Node.js

  • Typescript

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Remote Inside Sales Rep - AI-Enabled, Flexible Hours (Independent Contractor)
raw.excerpt: Remote, United States · Independent contractor (1099) · Part-time or full-time · For students, sales professionals, and anyone looking for flexible work Represent well-known brands and fast-growing startups to sharpen the phone skills AI can't replace, and earn uncapped commission in USD on your own schedule.
raw.description:
Remote, United States · Independent contractor (1099) · Part-time or full-time · For students, sales professionals, and anyone looking for flexible work

Represent well-known brands and fast-growing startups to sharpen the phone skills AI can't replace, and earn uncapped commission in USD on your own schedule.

At Sellfire, our mission is to help the next generation of sales professionals build great sales careers in a world of AI. This role is where that starts.

What you'll do

  • Make live outbound calls for fast-growing B2B tech companies, reaching gatekeepers and decision-makers

  • Use Sellfire's AI-enabled platform. It handles lead lists, call prep, dialing and coaching insights, so your time goes into real conversations

  • Book qualified meetings for our customers' sales teams

  • Get call-by-call feedback and coaching from Logic-Based Selling, our proven calling methodology

Why this beats a typical side job

  • Earn real money. You're paid for results: Commission for every qualified meeting that you set that the prospect attends. The better you get, the more you make.

  • Control your hours. Work any hours you choose between 8 AM and 9 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. Fit it around classes, another job, or family. Work as much or as little as you want. No shifts and no minimum schedule.

  • Choose your accounts. Pick which customer programs you call for.

  • Work with brands that are going places. You'll call on behalf of well-known brands and fast-growing startups. That's real experience with venture-backed startups and brands hiring managers recognize.

  • Build a résumé recruiters notice. Entry-level SDR roles are among the most common first jobs in tech sales, and they usually ask for experience you can't get in a classroom. You'll walk away with real numbers like dials, connects and meetings booked.

  • Train like a pro before you dial. Learn through short video lessons, test what you know with quizzes, and practice live calls with AI prospects that act like real gatekeepers and decision-makers.

Your first step on the sales career ladder

In tech, the SDR (sales development rep) role is the most common way into sales. Many of today's top account executives, sales leaders and founders started there. A typical path looks like this:

  • SDR / BDR. Open conversations, qualify prospects and book meetings. This is where you start.

  • Account Executive. Run demos, manage deals and close revenue, often after a year or two as an SDR.

  • Senior AE, Sales Manager or Sales Leader. Bigger deals, a team of your own, or a seat in leadership.

The hardest part is getting that first SDR job without experience. This role gives you real experience and results to point to, whether you're in school, working another job, or switching careers.

Why build a career in sales

  • High earning potential. Sales pay is tied directly to results, so strong performers can out-earn their peers early in their careers.

  • Fast, merit-based growth. Your numbers speak for themselves, so promotions come from performance, not tenure.

  • Skills that transfer anywhere. Persuasion, listening, resilience and handling objections help in any job, or in starting your own company.

  • Demand in every industry. Every company needs revenue, so good salespeople are needed everywhere.

  • A path to leadership and entrepreneurship. Many founders and executives got their start in sales.

  • Skills AI can't easily replace. As AI takes over routine work, the ability to build trust in a live conversation becomes more valuable.

Who we're looking for

  • Based in the United States

  • Anyone looking for flexible, part-time work they can fit around school, another job, or family

  • College students and recent grads

  • Sales professionals looking to refine their skills and make extra money

  • Anyone looking to start their sales career

  • Competitive, coachable, and comfortable hearing "no"

  • Clear, confident speaker

  • A quiet place to work, a reliable computer, a headset, and stable internet (you'll pass a short equipment check)

About the contractor role

This is an independent contractor (1099) position, not employment with Sellfire. As a contractor:

  • You set your own hours within the 8 AM to 9 PM US Eastern Time window and decide how much you work

  • You provide and maintain your own equipment

  • You choose which customer programs to work on

  • You're paid 100% commission for results, not hourly, and you're responsible for your own taxes

  • You don't receive employee benefits such as health insurance or paid time off

The only things we require: pass screening and the equipment check, complete certification, and meet our quality standards on every call, including sticking to each customer's approved script.

How it works

  1. Apply (5 minutes)

  2. Complete a short screening and equipment check

  3. Finish Sellfire training and certification

  4. Start calling on your own schedule

raw.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Haitian Creole-English Video-Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Haitian Creole Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $17 - $20 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:


The Haitian Creole Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Haitian Creole and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inHaitian Creole and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for 14 (Fourteen) days from the posting date of October 30, 2026.


EEO/AA

LLS is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that employment opportunities are made and offered to individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law or local ordinance. LLS will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities if the person is otherwise qualified to safely perform all of the essential functions of the position. Should you require accommodations to complete this application and/or the interview process, please let us know immediately.​

Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.

Compliance with Disability Laws. It is the policy of LanguageLine that qualified individuals with disabilities not be discriminated against because of their disabilities in regard to job application procedures, hiring, and other terms and conditions of employment. It is also our policy to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of the employment process. We are prepared to modify or adjust the job application process or the job or work environment to make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of the applicant or employee to enable the applicant or employee to be considered for the position he or she desires, to perform the essential functions of the position in question, or to enjoy equal benefits and privileges of employment as are enjoyed by other similarly situated employees without disabilities, unless the accommodation will impose an undue hardship.

VEVRAA Federal Contractor requesting appropriate employment service delivery systems, such as state workforce agencies and local employment delivery systems, to provide priority referrals of protected veterans.

PAY TRANSPARENCY NONDISCRIMINATION PROVISION
The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-I.35(c)

raw.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Stockbroking
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

As a Technical Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to Dell Technologies' customers, ensuring they realize maximum value from their investments in Dell solutions. You will act as a bridge between customers and Dell's internal teams — including Sales, Professional Services, Product, and Engineering — driving adoption, retention, and satisfaction.

  • Drive Customer Success & Risk Reduction: Lead regular business reviews, proactively identify risks, prevent incidents and escalations, and improve overall customer experience.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to deliver seamless customer outcomes.
  • Provide Strategic Insights: Share customer feedback to influence product improvements, while staying current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and Dell's evolving solutions.

Take the first step towards your dream career

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Project Management, or a similar customer-facing business role.

Desirable Requirements

En Logicalis Spain estamos buscando un MongoDB Platform Engineer. El equipo de Data & Analytics de Logicalistrabaja con clientes nacionales e internacionales, llevando a cabo importantes proyectos de ingeniería de datos, inteligencia artificial y analítica avanzada, estrategia del dato, gobierno, integración y arquitectura, abarcando todo el ciclo de vida del dato.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Diseñar e implantar arquitecturas de MongoDB en entornos de producción, garantizando su escalabilidad y rendimiento.

  • Gestionar despliegues sobre VMs Linux, optimizando la configuración de sistemas, almacenamiento y red.

  • Definir e implementar estrategias de alta disponibilidad, seguridad, backup y recuperación ante desastres.

  • Implementar soluciones de monitorización y documentar procedimientos operativos y buenas prácticas.

  • Experiencia con Replica Sets y Sharded Clusters, incluyendo operaciones de mantenimiento y alta disponibilidad.

  • Conocimientos sólidos de administración de Linux, almacenamiento, redes y rendimiento.

  • Experiencia en seguridad, autenticación, cifrado y control de accesos en MongoDB.

  • Experiencia en estrategias de backup, restauración, monitorización y automatización.

BENEFICIOS

>Incorporación inmediata a compañía líder del sector IT con un alto grado de expertise en el área de Data & Analytics dónde nos encontramos en pleno proceso de expansión.

>Estabilidad laboral a través de contrato indefinido con amplias oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y crecimiento en la compañía.

>Paquete retributivo muy competitivo acorde a la valía del candidato.

> Posibilidad de acogerse a planes de retribución flexible (tarjeta restaurante, tarjeta transporte y tarjeta guardería).

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is based in Taiwan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Taiwan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
